title: Content Specialist
description:
Our purpose


ecoPortal health and safety engagement software helps organisations amplify workplace safety. We give leaders the data they need to create awe-inspiring safety cultures that ignite their team’s potential.


Engaged teams are the beating heart of industry-leading, odds-defying workplaces, and we’re committed to helping clients achieve that.


Our mission is simple: create engaged cultures and healthier environments for all.

Who we are


We’re a real tech success story, built from the ground up with a vision of transforming the health and safety industry as we know it.


Through our years, we’re anchored by our commitment to championing people. That commitment begins from the ground up... with our own team.


Our team culture is an organic creation built by our people, for our people. Differences are celebrated here, and we firmly believe that our diverse lived experiences work together to make us stronger as a whole.



The Opportunity


The Content Specialist is an exciting role in ecoPortal’s marketing team, directly contributing to our content strategy. You’ll be part of a team with big aspirations, changing perceptions of health and safety worldwide.



Ideal for someone who has:


  • A Bachelors (or higher) Degree in marketing/ journalism/ communications or similar major.
  • Exceptional written and verbal English fluency.
  • A strong understanding of SEO and CRO copywriting.
  • A flair for story-telling, with the ability to demonstrate technical writing.
  • A passion for writing with an excellent eye for detail, grammar, brand tone and style.
  • Experience in marketing in a tech and/or SaaS company is an advantage.
  • An understanding of the buyer journey and how best to capture people's interest at each stage.
  • Experience in managing Podcasts, Webinars and live content events.
  • The ability to meet deadlines, be a self-starter and have a can-do attitude.
  • Great communication skills, with the ability to liaise with both internal and external stakeholders regularly.


Key Responsibilities


  • Execution of the company’s content strategy, with the aim of educating, engaging, entertaining and empowering people across the company’s full customer lifecycle.
  • Be a driving force behind the execution of a broad range of top-notch content including ad campaigns, web copy, email marketing, blogs, case studies, webinars, event collateral, videos and more.
  • Planning webinar and podcast series and managing all production aspects, from prospecting and inviting potential speakers to writing briefings and scripts and supporting the recording or live delivery.
  • Creation of compelling monthly and quarterly newsletters, with ongoing performance tracking and a focus on finding new ways to improve engagement.
  • Keep your finger on the pulse of what’s front of mind for professionals in the world of health and safety and use that to input on content and campaign idea generation.
  • Support the Sales and Success teams by creating targeted collateral, emails, social posts and case studies to drive conversions and upsell opportunities;
  • Support the company’s SEO initiatives, scope and create content that helps the company get found via organic traffic;
  • Contribute to ecoPortal’s content strategy and execution.
  • Take a campaign approach to content development. Implement SEO best practices, test, and iterate your content and creative processes with the aim of increasing ecoPortal’s reach, generating demand, and converting prospects to customers.
  • Support other team-wide initiatives with targeted collateral (i.e. web, email) that leverages strong storytelling to get key ecoPortal messages across in inspiring and unique ways;
  • Keep your work in Trello and the content calendar up-to-date and set up other administrative processes as required;
  • Closely monitor new content trends, and proactively seek creative opportunities where these can be best utilised at the company.
  • Own and manage our content partnership relationships, agreements and event partner content.
  • Collaborate with other Creative Team members, including Graphic Designers, Video Specialists, as well as members of the Digital Marketing Team.
  • Contribute to brand and content reporting as required.
  • Support the Content Marketing Manager and wider marketing team in other areas of the business that align with your skillset as required.



Perks & Benefits:


We hope that you're excited by the possibilities that come with working at ecoPortal! In addition to our welcoming and diverse culture, we also offer these fun perks and benefits.


37-Hour Work Week & Flexible Working: We prioritise work-life balance by offering a 37-hour workweek and flexible working arrangements. Some of your working hours will be aligned with the New Zealand time zone to ensure collaboration with the team.


⛺️ Generous Annual Leave


Birthday Perk: You get to take your birthday off! If it falls on a weekend, you can choose a day close to your birthday to celebrate. Milestone Birthdays are celebrated extra special with ecoPortal.


End-of-Year Celebration: Enter the draw for a chance to join the team at ecoPortal HQ in New Zealand for our epic end-of-year celebrations! The longer you’ve been with eP, the more entries you get. We've got flights, accommodation, and meals all covered while you’re here. ✈️ ️


Professional Development: ecoPortal offer financial assistance for Business English Language Courses, apps, or training.


❤️

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
We are still looking for talent… and we would love for you to join our team!

For over 25 years, UST has worked alongside the world’s best companies to make a real impact through business transformation. Driven by technology, inspired by people, and guided by our purpose, UST supports clients from design to implementation. Together, with more than 30,000 employees in 30 countries, we build to create limitless impact, reaching billions of lives in the process.


We are looking for an experienced L2 Support Analyst to provide functional production support for enterprise Contract Management Software (CMS/CLM) platforms. This role focuses on incident resolution, configuration support, and close collaboration with business users and technical teams to ensure system stability and efficient contract operations.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide Level 2 production support for Contract Management Software platforms, including incident, problem, and service request management.
  • Analyze and resolve issues related to:
  • Contract templates, clause libraries, and fallback logic
  • Workflows, approvals, and business rule configurations
  • Metadata, attributes, and contract type setups
  • Perform root cause analysis for recurring functional and configuration-related issues.
  • Support minor enhancements and functional configuration changes (non-code).
  • Troubleshoot integration-related issues and coordinate with Level 3 technical teams when required.
  • Manage user access, role assignments, and permission-related issues.
  • Execute approved data corrections, metadata updates, and configuration fixes.
  • Support UAT and regression testing for fixes and minor platform updates.
  • Maintain support documentation, knowledge articles, and operational runbooks.
  • Collaborate closely with L1 support teams, business stakeholders, and L3 technical teams to ensure timely issue resolution.


Required Skills & Experience

  • 3+ years of experience providing production support for Contract Management Software (CLM/CMS) platforms (e.g., Icertis, Coupa CLM, DocuSign CLM, SAP CLM, or similar).
  • Strong hands-on experience with functional configurations, including:
  • Contract templates and clause libraries
  • Workflows, rules, and approvals
  • English (B2- Fluent)
  • Metadata, attributes, and contract types
  • Solid understanding of contract lifecycle management processes .
  • Experience working with ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow).
  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting enterprise SaaS applications in complex or regulated environments.
  • Exposure to system integrations with ERP, CRM, or document management platforms.
  • Familiarity with ITIL-based support models or Agile delivery environments.


UST is waiting for you!

title: Virtual Assistant - Real Estate Operations & Marketing
description:
Polaris Advisors is a high-performing real estate team at Compass , specializing in residential sales, investments, and advisory services in South Florida. Known for its strategic approach, strong operational structure, and client-focused execution, Polaris Advisors delivers a high-level experience across every stage of the real estate process.


We are seeking a high-performing Virtual Assistant based in Brazil to support our Real Estate Operations and Marketing team at a high-producing team at Compass . This is a remote position for candidates located in Brazil , compensated in Brazilian Reais (BRL) .


This role requires a professional who is highly organized, detail-oriented, tech-savvy , and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven U.S. real estate environment .


You will work closely with the Real Estate Operations Manager and the Principal of the team , supporting property listings, marketing initiatives, and operational workflows. This position is ideal for someone who takes ownership of their work, communicates clearly, and consistently delivers high-quality execution.


Training will be provided on MLS systems and the Compass platform , and the ideal candidate must demonstrate a strong ability to quickly learn and adapt to new tools and technologies.


Key Responsibilities


Administrative Operations

• Prepare and manage buyer and seller documentation using the Compass platform

• Organize and maintain internal trackers, digital files, and compliance documentation using Google Drive and Compass systems

• Maintain the listing and transaction pipeline with accurate and up-to-date information

• Coordinate post-closing follow-ups, including testimonial requests


Listing & Deal Coordination

• Coordinate listing preparation, including ordering photography, signage, and related services

• Upload and manage listings across Compass, MLS, Zillow, and related platforms

• Prepare marketing materials, including social media posts, open house flyers, and email blasts

• Ensure full compliance with Compass systems and listing requirements

• Monitor and update status changes across all platforms in real time


Marketing & Lead Management

• Design and distribute e-blasts, brochures, newsletters, and social media posts using the Compass Marketing Center

• Manage the team’s Instagram and Facebook pages, supporting content creation, scheduling, and posting

• Coordinate print campaigns and seasonal marketing drops, including mail execution via Postalytics

• Support lead management and follow-ups as needed


Events & Client Support

• Present and organize vendor quotes (venues, invitations, catering, promotional items)

• Support team events and client-facing initiatives as needed

Qualifications

• Minimum 3+ years of experience in a support role such as Executive Assistant, Operations, or Marketing

• Real estate experience strongly preferred, particularly in U.S. real estate operations

• Tech-savvy, with hands-on experience using: Google Workspace, E-signature tools, CRM systems, Canva, and AI (ChatGPT)

• Strong written communication skills, with excellent grammar and clarity

• Highly detail-oriented and process-driven, with the ability to manage follow-ups, deadlines, and shifting priorities independently

• Ability to organize tasks, track progress, and proactively flag issues

• Professional, confident, and polished demeanor when interacting with clients, agents, and vendors

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, time-sensitive real estate environment

• Ability to work independently while maintaining clear, proactive communication and status updates

• Advanced English required; Spanish is a plus


Compensation & Perks

• R$4,000 per month (paid in Brazilian Reais)

• This is a remote position, compensated in BRL (R$)

• Performance-based growth opportunities are available. Compensation and responsibilities may be reviewed based on performance, consistency, and contribution to the team.

Nossa plataforma se destaca em tecnologias de processamento de transações de baixa latência e está disponível tanto on-premise quanto em nuvem.

Priorizamos VISÃO, AGILIDADE e VELOCIDADE para oferecer experiências excepcionais aos clientes e construímos relacionamentos duradouros e de confiança com algumas das principais instituições financeiras, fintechs e empresas comerciais em todo o mundo.

Adotamos uma forte cultura de risco e esperamos que toda a nossa equipe, independentemente do cargo que ocupem, tenha uma atitude proativa e responsável em relação à gestão de riscos. A Lynx se orgulha de ser uma organização com igualdade de oportunidades, independentemente de identidade de gênero, cultura ou deficiência. Nossa missão é contribuir para que mais pessoas e empresas prosperem.


O que você vai fazer

Como Professional Services Technician, seu objetivo será garantir um serviço excelente para nossos clientes sediados no Brasil (e em outras regiões da América Latina), participando ativamente das diferentes etapas do ciclo de vida: onboarding, implantação, acompanhamento e novas necessidades.

Precisamos de alguém como você para nos ajudar em diferentes frentes:

· Liderar e gerir projetos de implementação das nossas soluções.

· Gerenciar o relacionamento com os clientes: identificar novas necessidades, resolver dúvidas e oferecer orientação sobre o uso correto das nossas soluções.

· Fornecer consultoria especializada e executar os serviços profissionais das nossas soluções de Detecção e Prevenção de Crime Financeiro e Lavagem de Dinheiro.

· Dar suporte técnico aos nossos times internos de Vendas nas fases iniciais de contato com clientes: demos, reuniões técnicas etc.

· Atuar como elo entre nossos clientes e as equipes de Desenvolvimento e Suporte.


✅ O que buscamos em você

Experiência em gestão de projetos de tecnologia;

Ensino superior completo;

Experiência prévia em instituições financeiras ou empresas relacionadas ao setor;

Experiência em departamentos de Serviços Profissionais em outras empresas do setor;

Idiomas: domínio avançado de inglês (mandatório).


✅ O que pode contar pontos a mais

Conhecimentos de Linux – nível usuário.

Espanhol avançado;

Conhecimento em Fraude e/ou Lavagem de Dinheiro;

Capacidade para trabalhar em equipe;

Boas habilidades de comunicação;

Capacidade de se adaptar a ambientes em constante mudança.


Seguinte passo

Candidate-se e se você conhece alguém que possa estar procurando por essa oportunidade, compartilhe.

title: Analista Fiscal - Contabilidade - Departamento Fiscal
description:
Descrição da Empresa A Salus Contabilidade é um escritório localizado em Chapecó (SC), especializado em serviços contábeis e tributários descomplicados e personalizados, com foco em abertura de empresas, gestão financeira e atendimento ágil.


Descrição do Cargo Estamos em busca de um Analista Fiscal para integrar nossa equipe em Chapecó, SC. As principais responsabilidades incluem acompanhar e realizar atividades relacionadas a apuração de impostos, elaborar relatórios fiscais, realizar análises tributárias e assegurar o cumprimento das obrigações fiscais e acessórias. O cargo requer busca constante por melhorias nos processos fiscais. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e presencial.


Qualificações

  • Habilidade de escrituração, lançamento e importação de Notas Fiscais;

  • Capacidade de realizar análises tributárias detalhadas para identificar conformidades e oportunidades.

title: Virtual Assistant - Real Estate Operations & Marketing
description:
Polaris Advisors is a high-performing real estate team at Compass , specializing in residential sales, investments, and advisory services in South Florida. Known for its strategic approach, strong operational structure, and client-focused execution, Polaris Advisors delivers a high-level experience across every stage of the real estate process.


We are seeking a high-performing Virtual Assistant based in Brazil to support our Real Estate Operations and Marketing team at a high-producing team at Compass . This is a remote position for candidates located in Brazil , compensated in Brazilian Reais (BRL) .


This role requires a professional who is highly organized, detail-oriented, tech-savvy , and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven U.S. real estate environment .


You will work closely with the Real Estate Operations Manager and the Principal of the team , supporting property listings, marketing initiatives, and operational workflows. This position is ideal for someone who takes ownership of their work, communicates clearly, and consistently delivers high-quality execution.


Training will be provided on MLS systems and the Compass platform , and the ideal candidate must demonstrate a strong ability to quickly learn and adapt to new tools and technologies.


Key Responsibilities


Administrative Operations

• Prepare and manage buyer and seller documentation using the Compass platform

• Organize and maintain internal trackers, digital files, and compliance documentation using Google Drive and Compass systems

• Maintain the listing and transaction pipeline with accurate and up-to-date information

• Coordinate post-closing follow-ups, including testimonial requests


Listing & Deal Coordination

• Coordinate listing preparation, including ordering photography, signage, and related services

• Upload and manage listings across Compass, MLS, Zillow, and related platforms

• Prepare marketing materials, including social media posts, open house flyers, and email blasts

• Ensure full compliance with Compass systems and listing requirements

• Monitor and update status changes across all platforms in real time


Marketing & Lead Management

• Design and distribute e-blasts, brochures, newsletters, and social media posts using the Compass Marketing Center

• Manage the team’s Instagram and Facebook pages, supporting content creation, scheduling, and posting

• Coordinate print campaigns and seasonal marketing drops, including mail execution via Postalytics

• Support lead management and follow-ups as needed


Events & Client Support

• Present and organize vendor quotes (venues, invitations, catering, promotional items)

• Support team events and client-facing initiatives as needed

Qualifications

• Minimum 3+ years of experience in a support role such as Executive Assistant, Operations, or Marketing

• Real estate experience strongly preferred, particularly in U.S. real estate operations

• Tech-savvy, with hands-on experience using: Google Workspace, E-signature tools, CRM systems, Canva, and AI (ChatGPT)

• Strong written communication skills, with excellent grammar and clarity

• Highly detail-oriented and process-driven, with the ability to manage follow-ups, deadlines, and shifting priorities independently

• Ability to organize tasks, track progress, and proactively flag issues

• Professional, confident, and polished demeanor when interacting with clients, agents, and vendors

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, time-sensitive real estate environment

• Ability to work independently while maintaining clear, proactive communication and status updates

• Advanced English required; Spanish is a plus


Compensation & Perks

• R$4,000 per month (paid in Brazilian Reais)

• This is a remote position, compensated in BRL (R$)

• Opportunity for growth as the team and responsibilities expand

• Performance-based growth opportunities are available. Compensation and responsibilities may be reviewed based on performance, consistency, and contribution to the team.

• Work Schedule (Eastern Time):

Monday, Wednesday, Friday: 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM

Tuesday and Thursday: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM

• Paid time off:

7 holidays

First year: 1 week of paid vacation

From the second year onward: 2 weeks of paid vacation

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Software
description:
Somos uma empresa de tecnologia criada para transformar o mercado de serviços financeiros no Brasil e na América Latina. Estamos crescendo rápido, integrando novos negócios, acelerando inovação e construindo com intenção e consistência a cultura que sustentará nosso futuro.

Cultura, para nós, não é discurso: é sistema, prática e forma de operar.

E agora buscamos alguém que venha construir isso junto.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


SUA MISSÃO:

A pessoa coordenadora atua como uma ponte entre a estratégia macro e a execução, garantindo que os times de Product Owners/Managers, Frontend e Backend tenham os recursos, a orientação e o ambiente necessários para entregar valor constante ao negócio.

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

OKRs da área e que as dependências entre times sejam gerenciadas com eficiência.

Engenharia), traduzindo prioridades e gerenciando expectativas de curto e médio prazo.

O QUE ESPERAMOS QUE VOCÊ SAIBA:

• Experiência sólida como Desenvolvedor; domínio de metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban); conhecimento em métricas de produto (NPS, Churn, LTV, conversão); experiência com ferramentas de gestão (Jira, Notion, etc.).

• Liderança servidora, habilidade em resolução de conflitos, comunicação clara e assertiva, capacidade de dar e receber feedbacks construtivos e organização multitarefa.

• Conhecimento básico em pelo menos uma linguagem de programação para backend nas linguagens Ruby on Rails, Java, C#, Node.js, Python, PHP.

• Noções de bancos de dados relacionais e linguagem SQL (ex: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL

Server).

Conhecimento básico sobre o funcionamento de APis REST.

• Domínio de um framework (React, Vue, Angular) e seu ecossistema.

• Profundo conhecimento em gerenciamento de estado (Redux, Vuex, Zustand, etc.).

• Experiência sólida com ferramentas de build (Webpack, Vite) e pré-processadores

(SASS).

• Habilidade em criar e manter testes automatizados (Jest, Cypress).

• ¡OS Nativo (Swift):

• Domínio de padrões de arquitetura (MVVM, VIPER).

• Profundo conhecimento em SwiftUl e/ou UIKit para layouts complexos.

• Experiência com gerenciamento de dependências (Swift Package Manager, CocoaPods) e concorrência (GCD, Swift Concurrency).

• Android Nativo (Kotlin):

• Domínio de padrões de arquitetura (MVVM, MVI) e dos componentes Jetpack.

• Profundo conhecimento em Jetpack Compose e/ou XML para layouts complexos.

• Experiência com Coroutines/Flow para programação assíncrona e Dagger/Hilt para injeção de dependência.

• Flutter (Dart):

• Domínio de padrões de gerenciamento de estado avançados (BLoC, Riverpod).

• Habilidade em criar widgets customizados e complexos.

• Experiência com canais de plataforma (platform channels) para integração com código nativo.

• Mentalidade Orientada a Dados: Capacidade de tomar decisões baseadas em evidências.

• Empatia pelo Cliente: Um desejo profundo de entender e resolver os problemas dos usuários.

• Espírito Colaborativo: Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe com desenvolvedores, designers, marketing e outras áreas.

• Resiliência e Adaptação: Capacidade de navegar em ambientes de incerteza e mudar de curso

quando necessário.


O Que Oferecemos:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Talent Acquisition Manager – NAMER
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Manager to lead and scale recruitment operations for NAMER (North America) clients within an AI/R company structure. This role is responsible for building high-performing talent acquisition strategies to support growth in cutting-edge areas such as Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and advanced software engineering.

You will act as a strategic partner to clients and internal leadership, ensuring hiring excellence, speed, quality, and alignment with business goals in a highly competitive and innovation-driven market.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end talent acquisition strategies for NAMER clients, managing full-cycle recruitment across technical roles within AI/R and technology environments;
  • Partner closely with clients, hiring managers, and executives to understand workforce planning, role requirements, and hiring priorities;
  • Build, manage, and develop high-performing recruiting teams, ensuring delivery excellence, hiring quality, and adherence to SLAs;
  • Design and optimize recruiting processes tailored to the NAMER market, including sourcing strategies, interview frameworks, and candidate experience;
  • Drive hiring initiatives for highly specialized roles, including AI Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers, Data Scientists, Cloud Engineers, and Product roles;
  • Act as a trusted advisor to clients, providing market insights, talent trends and compensation benchmarks;
  • Ensure compliance with NAMER labor regulations, diversity hiring practices, and internal recruitment standards;
  • Manage recruiting metrics and KPIs;
  • Support employer branding initiatives and represent the company in talent and industry events when applicable;
  • Collaborate with HR, People Operations, and leadership teams to align talent acquisition with broader organizational strategy.


Required Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a Talent Acquisition Manager or Senior Talent Acquisition Partner in technology-driven environments;
  • Strong experience recruiting for the NAMER market, with a primary focus on US hiring practices;
  • Demonstrated success hiring for AI, Machine Learning, Data, Cloud, and software engineering roles;
  • Experience managing recruiting teams and working with multiple stakeholders and clients simultaneously;
  • Deep knowledge of full-cycle recruitment, sourcing strategies, and talent market dynamics in NAMER;
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills;
  • Experience working in fast-paced, scaling, or consulting environments.
  • Advanced English
  • Strong data-driven mindset

title: Tech Lead React
description:
Tech Lead | React Web

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.


Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.



Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?



Qual será o seu papel?

Você atuará como Tech Lead React Web, sendo a referência técnica do time e também alguém que trabalha de forma ativa no desenvolvimento. Seu papel envolve orientar a equipe, garantir a qualidade das entregas, apoiar decisões técnicas, participar de entrevistas, promover as melhores práticas de frontend e assegurar que processos, documentação e ritmo de evolução do time estejam sempre alinhados. Além de liderar, você colocará a mão na massa na construção de interfaces, criação de componentes escaláveis e manutenção de uma base sólida de frontend, contribuindo diretamente para a experiência do usuário e para a evolução contínua do projeto.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Alinhar e acompanhar objetivos do time, garantindo que os processos da Rethink sejam seguidos;
  • Acompanhar a evolução das tarefas ao longo do ciclo de desenvolvimento, identificando riscos para a entrega e atuando para mitigá-los;
  • Liderar o desenvolvimento web, criando componentes reutilizáveis e escaláveis com React, desenvolvendo interfaces responsivas e acessíveis, e colaborando com design e backend;
  • Identificar e resolver problemas de desempenho para manter interfaces rápidas e confiáveis;
  • Realizar revisões de código, orientar padrões e propor melhorias contínuas;
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) em tecnologias e boas práticas de frontend;
  • Atuar como a principal referência técnica para o time e para o cliente, apoiando decisões, direcionando soluções e garantindo alinhamento entre necessidades do projeto e capacidades da equipe;
  • Conduzir entrevistas e avaliar candidatos para compor o time de TI sob sua responsabilidade, assegurando que o perfil técnico e comportamental esteja aderente às necessidades do projeto;
  • Garantir que o time mantenha atualizadas as ferramentas e artefatos essenciais ao fluxo de trabalho, como Jira, documentações e registros de processo, preservando organização, histórico e visibilidade;
  • Identificar oportunidades de capacitação e necessidades de desenvolvimento do time, promovendo nivelamento técnico e incentivando uma evolução contínua e estruturada da equipe;
  • Apoiar o time de projetos na elaboração de cronogramas e estimativas, trazendo visão técnica para planejar entregas, dimensionar esforço e antecipar riscos;
  • Desenvolver, implementar e otimizar interfaces responsivas e acessíveis, aplicando boas práticas de UX/UI e garantindo uma experiência fluida, inclusiva e eficiente para o usuário;
  • Liderar o desenvolvimento web, guiando decisões técnicas, garantindo a adoção de boas práticas e assegurando que o produto avance com qualidade, consistência e escalabilidade.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Domínio no desenvolvimento frontend utilizando React e seu ecossistema (Redux, React Router, Context API etc.);
  • Experiência com HTML5, CSS3 e pré-processadores de CSS (ex: SASS, LESS);
  • Familiaridade com testes de frontend (ex: Jest, React Testing Library).
  • Familiaridade com conceitos de User Experience (UX) e User Interface (UI);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de versionamento de código, preferencialmente Git;
  • Conhecimento em prototipagem de interfaces utilizando Figma ou outras ferramentas de design;
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);
  • Experiência com integração de APIs RESTful, com práticas de DevOps e pipelines de CI/CD aplicadas ao frontend;
  • Proatividade, perfil comunicativo, resolução de problemas complexos e busca por melhoria contínua.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Tiver experiência com TypeScript;
  • Tiver experiência com gerenciamento de dependências usando NPM e/ou YARN;
  • Conhecer bibliotecas de UI como Material UI, Ant Design ou similares;
  • Aplicar práticas de acessibilidade seguindo diretrizes como WCAG;
  • Tiver vivência com integrações em nuvem (AWS ou outras plataformas);
  • Conhecer princípios de SEO aplicados a aplicações web;
  • Tiver experiência com arquitetura de projetos complexos.



O que oferecemos aos nossos Rethinkers?

Básico que a gente ama

  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Kit de onboarding com todas as ferramentas essenciais e mimos exclusivos para Rethinkers

Saúde e bem-estar

  • Auxílio bem-estar mensal
  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico;
  • Saúde mental com a plataforma Conexa Saúde
  • Wellhub para cuidar do corpo em movimento
  • On Happy para planejar suas viagens à lazer



Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Mobile Engineer
description:

title: SAP Basis Analyst
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e carrega quase 30 anos de experiência por meio de suas companhias legadas, principalmente a partir da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants .

Iniciamos nossas operações no Brasil em 2007 como DISYS e, desde então, atendemos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, nos consolidamos como uma das maiores empresas de soluções e contratação em TI, entregando serviços que combinam escala global, portfólio completo e agilidade tática , apoiando a modernização de modelos de contratação, evolução de soluções de workforce e transformação tecnológica.

Possuímos escritórios em Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP) , mantendo proximidade com nossos clientes e consultores. Somos também uma Minority Owner Company , com forte compromisso com diversidade, inclusão e equidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro da nossa estratégia e representam nosso maior ativo. Nosso compromisso é atrair, desenvolver e reter talentos, criando conexões reais e duradouras.

Acreditamos que a combinação certa entre talento, tecnologia e organizações desbloqueia resultados transformadores e impulsiona o sucesso de clientes e consultores.

Nossos valores — Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia — orientam todas as nossas decisões.

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade. Nosso processo seletivo é inclusivo e aberto a profissionais de todas as identidades, experiências e trajetórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Você irá atuar em um cliente multinacional de grande porte , do setor de petróleo e gás.

  • Atuar em Follow The Sun (FTS) no suporte a incidentes para todos os sistemas SAP, incluindo ambientes SAP RISE .
  • Garantir integridade, disponibilidade e controles das instâncias SAP em ambientes híbridos (on-prem + cloud).

  • SAP NetWeaver ABAP e JAVA
  • SAP S/4HANA
  • SAP HANA Database

  • SAP Focused Run
  • SAP Cloud ALM

  • RFCs
  • Perfis SAP
  • Limpeza de file systems
  • Login groups e load balancing
  • Atuar como owner na análise e resolução de problemas de plataforma , utilizando práticas estruturadas de problem management.
  • Planejar e executar:
  • Upgrades de sistemas
  • Enhancement Packs
  • Atualizações de serviços em nuvem
  • Apoiar mudanças de infraestrutura, incluindo DB, SO e hardware , em ambientes híbridos.
  • Monitorar capacidade (CPU, disco, spool, memória) em sistemas on-prem e cloud.
  • Analisar e resolver problemas de performance , inclusive em ambientes SAP RISE.
  • Planejar e executar testes de Disaster Recovery e Cyber Recovery , incluindo cenários de failover em nuvem.
  • Responder a relatórios EarlyWatch e health checks específicos do SAP RISE .
  • Gerenciar jobs de housekeeping e scripts de automação.
  • Atuar em plantões rotativos (on-call) fora do horário comercial.
  • Construir e configurar sistemas SAP seguindo padrões corporativos, incluindo provisionamento e onboarding SAP RISE .


O que você precisa ter

No conforto da sua casa — regime 100% Home Office .

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Sênior (Node.js/TypeScript)
description:
Quem somos?


Somos uma healthtech de Ribeirão Preto - SP, com a missão de tornar as organizações da saúde mais eficientes, possibilitando a melhor assistência aos pacientes. Queremos ser reconhecidos como uma das maiores provedoras de serviços de informações a operadores de saúde!


No nosso ambiente de trabalho, procuramos sempre agir com base nos nossos valores. É através deles que chegaremos mais perto de alcançar nossos objetivos:

  • Trabalho em equipe;
  • Pense grande;
  • Excelente não é suficiente;
  • Fail fast, learn faster;
  • Inovar para revolucionar;
  • Simples sempre;
  • Só é bom pra gente se for bom pro cliente;


Qual o desafio?


Buscamos uma pessoa com visão arquitetural e experiência em alta escalabilidade para elevar o nível técnico do nosso time. Você terá papel fundamental na definição de padrões de engenharia e na construção de sistemas robustos que impactam diretamente a eficiência do setor de saúde.


O que você irá fazer no dia-a-dia?


Sua missão vai além de escrever código: você será uma referência técnica dentro da Carefy.


  • Interface Técnica com Clientes: Atuar como ponto focal em reuniões com os times de TI dos clientes (operadoras de saúde) para alinhar requisitos de integração, layouts de dados e especificações de API;
  • Gestão e Organização Técnica: Traduzir requisitos de negócio em tarefas técnicas claras, quebrando demandas complexas em entregáveis menores para orientar o trabalho dos desenvolvedores Juniors e Plenos;
  • Arquitetura e Design: Projetar e desenvolver soluções escaláveis, resilientes e de alta performance utilizando Node.js (NestJS/Next.js);
  • Sustentação e Confiabilidade: Atuar na manutenção dos sistemas em produção, identificando, diagnosticando e corrigindo bugs e falhas (em sistemas, fontes de dados e APIs) de forma ágil para garantir a continuidade dos serviços;
  • Mentoria e Qualidade: Realizar Code Reviews rigorosos e disseminar boas práticas (Clean Code, SOLID), elevando a barra técnica da equipe;
  • Padronização e Performance: Definir padrões de desenvolvimento e identificar gargalos de performance em cenários de alto volume de dados.


Qual o contexto?


Você fará parte do nosso time de integração. Somos os responsáveis pela interoperabilidade da Carefy. Nossa missão é conectar nossa plataforma aos ecossistemas heterogêneos das operadoras de saúde, garantindo que os dados fluam com segurança e performance. Neste time, você atuará como referência técnica : participando diretamente do desenho de soluções junto aos times de TI dos clientes e, internamente, traduzindo esses desafios complexos em uma arquitetura limpa e em demandas organizadas para orientar o desenvolvimento.


O que esperamos de você?


  • Visão Sistêmica: Capacidade de enxergar o impacto de uma decisão técnica em todo o ecossistema do produto.
  • Comunicação Assertiva: Habilidade de negociar soluções técnicas com clientes externos e guiar o time interno com clareza.
  • Autonomia com Responsabilidade: Habilidade para tocar projetos complexos com pouca supervisão, gerenciando riscos.
  • Resolução de Problemas: Foco na causa raiz e em soluções definitivas.


Quais são os requisitos?


  • Mínimo de 6 anos de experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de software;
  • Experiência de 4+ anos com Node.js e TypeScript em produção;
  • Experiência de 4+ anos Bancos de Dados Relacionais (MySQL) , incluindo modelagem e otimização;
  • Experiência comprovada com Arquitetura de Software (Clean Architecture, Hexagonal, DDD);
  • Experiência prática com Cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) e serviços de Mensageria (RabbitMQ/Kafka) ;
  • Experiência na criação e manutenção de APIs RESTful escaláveis;
  • Experiência prévia em ambientes de alta criticidade e volume de dados;
  • Domínio de frameworks modernos como NestJS e/ou Next.js ;
  • Conhecimento prático em testes automatizados (TDD , testes unitários e de integração);
  • Habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa.


Será um diferencial:


  • Experiência com PHP: Temos legado e integrações onde esse conhecimento será muito útil para modernização;
  • Experiência na sustentação de aplicações escaláveis utilizando Kubernetes e Terraform;
  • Vivência com pipelines de CI/CD (Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.);
  • Conhecimentos em Segurança da Informação (OWASP, OAuth2).


O que oferecemos?


  • Modalidade Flexível: Híbrido (para residentes em Ribeirão Preto e região) ou 100% Remoto (para candidatos de outras localidades);
  • Possibilidade de regime CLT ou PJ;
  • Se CLT, convênio com Bradesco Saúde e Cartão Flash (VA e VR);
  • Ambiente colaborativo e desafiador;
  • Horários flexíveis;
  • Autonomia para propor e implementar novas tecnologias!


Faça parte da nossa revolução na saúde!

title: Product Designer
description:
For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Product Designer to own the end-to-end user experience for our Carnegie Audiences suite of products (careerexplorer.com and supplemental products), including the integration and design of new Agentic AI interactions. You will be responsible for translating complex user needs and business goals into intuitive, elegant, and effective design solutions. This role requires a strong focus on core user experience, user flows, and wireframing, in addition to high-quality visual user interface (UI) execution.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • User Experience (UX) Strategy and Design
  • Lead the design process from initial concept and user research through to final implementation and iteration, focusing on complex user flows, information architecture, and system design.
  • Develop and refine wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups to communicate design intent and test hypotheses with users and stakeholders.
  • Conduct usability testing, analyze user data, and gather feedback to drive continuous improvement of the product experience.
  • Design and integrate Agentic AI experiences into product flows, ensuring a seamless, trustworthy, and effective interaction between the user and the AI system.
  • User Interface (UI) Design and Visual Execution
  • Create polished, high-fidelity visual designs and detailed design specifications that adhere to brand guidelines and accessibility standards.
  • Maintain and contribute to our existing Design System, ensuring consistency, scalability, and efficiency across all product touchpoints.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all product outputs, focusing on design principles that enhance clarity and drive user adoption.
  • Data Product Development
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate strategic requirements into data product features.
  • Direct the building and maintenance of data-centric applications and tools that leverage machine learning insights.
  • Implement and manage MLOps and CI/CD workflows for efficient model and data product deployments.
  • Ensure data governance, quality, and integrity across all analytical solutions.
  • Collaboration and Implementation
  • Partner closely with Product Managers to define product strategy and requirements, ensuring design solutions align with business objectives and technical constraints.
  • Collaborate with front-end engineers to ensure accurate design implementation and a seamless, high-quality user experience post-launch.
  • Participate in agile development processes, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and design critiques.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • UX/UI Acumen: Exceptional ability to translate strategic product goals into logical user flows and visually compelling, intuitive user interfaces, evidenced by a strong public portfolio of work on consumer-facing web products.
  • Technical Design Proficiency: Expertise in current design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD) for creating high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, and specifications.
  • Design Ownership and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a design portfolio autonomously, proactively identify design opportunities, and take ownership of the product’s end-to-end user experience.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively navigate complex design challenges and continuously seek elegant solutions that balance user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility.

title: Senior C/C++ engineer with Python
description:
Project Description:

Founded in 1984, our client is one of the world's leading provider of lithography systems for the semiconductor industry, manufacturing complex machines that are critical to the production of integrated circuits or chips. The client has its R&D and manufacturing operations in The Netherlands.

Luxoft is currently searching to augment the Development & Engineering Department with a talented software engineer to design and implement embedded software for systems among the highest precision ever produced in the world.

  • During testing, you will collect the necessary data so you can write a test report.
  • The development environment is Red Hat Linux, execution environment is Wind River Linux. The software release driving a client machine is 40 million lines of code. Client SW teams work in various modes such as Agile and SAFE.

  • Version control using command line is also required - Git, Clear Case and SVN, in this order of priority.

  • English: C1 Advanced

title: Senior Cloud SRE
description:
Cloud Infrastructure SRE / Tier 4 Engineer

As a Cloud Infrastructure SRE / Tier 4 Engineer , you will join a specialized engineering task force dedicated to preventing and resolving the most critical and strategic customer issues encountered in the field.

Our global team of experienced engineers has a deep understanding of the lower layers of private cloud infrastructure. Together, we work on practical solutions, continuously learning and adapting. We collaborate closely, share knowledge, and tackle challenges head-on.

If you're an engineer eager to understand the core of cloud technologies and looking for a team that values hands-on expertise , you'll fit right in with us.


What you will learn and contribute to

  • Maintain and enhance Red Hat private cloud: You’ll work extensively with Nokia Container Services (NCS) and CloudBand Infrastructure Software (CBIS) , private cloud solutions based on Kubernetes and OpenStack .
  • Deep Dive Troubleshooting: Starting from high-level Kubernetes error messages, you’ll navigate through multiple layers until pinpointing issues—even down to kernel-level bugs.
  • Automate and Develop: Spend 30–50% of your time developing automation to prevent recurring issues. Solve it once, automate for the future. Use your Python skills to create health checks and improve reliability.
  • Continuous Learning: In our rapidly evolving tech landscape, ongoing learning is a cornerstone.
  • Collaborate with Developers and Engineers: Work closely with developers and product engineers to bridge infrastructure and software, ensuring seamless product delivery.
  • Mode of Operation: This role requires participation in a follow-the-sun scheme with 12-hour shifts (within regulatory limits) or participation in on-call rotations to ensure business continuity during emergencies.


Your skills and experience

  • Linux Expertise: Strong familiarity with Linux distributions; we primarily use Red Hat and CentOS .
  • Networking Foundations: Solid understanding of networking fundamentals (VLANs, IP routing). Experience with Calico , Multus , and Open vSwitch is a plus.
  • Problem-Solving Mindset: Excellent troubleshooting skills and analytical thinking to address complex challenges.
  • Scripting and Automation: Proficiency in Bash and Python , or willingness to learn, plus familiarity with Ansible .
  • Containerization & Virtualization: Knowledge of Podman , Kubernetes , Helm , and/or OpenStack ; experience with KVM/QEMU is advantageous.
  • Storage Systems: Experience with Ceph and Rook is highly valued.
  • Database Expertise: Understanding of relational databases (MySQL , MariaDB ) and experience with etcd .
  • Monitoring and Logging: Familiarity with tools like ELK (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) , Prometheus , and Grafana .
  • Advanced written and spoken English.


It would be nice if you also had

  • Proactive thinking and ownership mindset.
  • Strong focus on quality and reliability.
  • Passion for delivering training or knowledge-sharing sessions to operations teams.

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

description:

title: Network Automation Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Network Automation Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable automation frameworks that ensure the quality, reliability, and continuous delivery of network and software services. This role focuses on developing robust automated test solutions, integrating them into CI/CD pipelines, and driving end-to-end test coverage across web, API, and network layers. The ideal candidate combines strong automation expertise with modern DevOps practices and familiarity with AI-enabled full-stack development.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, reusable automated test frameworks for network and software systems.
  • Implement and maintain automation for web, API, and network layers.
  • Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines and Xray to validate APIs, software components, and end-to-end service workflows.
  • Develop scalable automation solutions to support continuous delivery and high-quality releases.
  • Monitor automation pipelines, analyze failures, and maintain regression test suites to ensure system stability.
  • Collaborate with network engineers, developers, and DevOps teams to embed quality into the development lifecycle.
  • Leverage AI tools and techniques to enhance automation, testing, and application workflows where applicable.


Required Technical Skills

  • Python
  • Jinja2
  • YANG models for network automation and validation
  • Robot Framework / Pytest
  • Understanding of typing and data modeling
  • Test case design and behavior-driven development (BDD)
  • CI/CD pipeline integration
  • Git-based source control management
  • Pipeline monitoring, reporting, and regression management
  • Familiarity with AI tools and frameworks is beneficial
  • Experience integrating AI capabilities into applications is beneficial

title: Data Visualization Specialist
description:
About the Product:

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Role Summary:

We are looking for a technical builder to own our data visualization layer. You will develop custom, interactive data products for our customers using Shiny for Python and maintain rapid internal reporting using Looker Studio.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Data Visualization Product Development (Shiny for Python)
  • Architect, build, and deploy production-grade, highly-interactive data applications for customer-facing delivery using the Shiny for Python framework.
  • Lead the full development lifecycle, encompassing the design of intuitive user interfaces (UI) and the implementation of robust, performant server-side logic and reactivity.
  • Implement best practices for code quality, testing, modularization (e.g., Shiny modules), and deployment on platforms like Posit Connect to ensure a reliable and scalable data product experience.
  • Business Intelligence and Internal Reporting Management
  • Serve as the owner and subject matter expert for the internal Business Intelligence environment, primarily utilizing Looker Studio.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated dashboards and reports that deliver timely and actionable insights to internal stakeholders, effectively replacing manual reporting processes.
  • Apply advanced BI techniques, including the creation of complex calculated fields and data blending, to integrate diverse datasets for a unified view of performance.
  • Data Querying and Performance Optimization
  • Develop, optimize, and maintain efficient, production-ready SQL queries, leveraging advanced techniques such as Common Table Expressions (CTEs) and window functions.
  • Actively manage the performance layer of data visualization products, ensuring both Shiny applications and Looker Studio reports execute quickly and maintain responsiveness under anticipated data volumes and user load.
  • Collaborate closely with Data Engineering teams to understand and leverage the underlying data warehouse structure (e.g., Python, SQL).
  • User Experience (UX) and Data Design
  • Translate complex, multi-dimensional datasets into clean, visually compelling, and intuitive user experiences, moving beyond simple table and chart outputs to sophisticated data narratives.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all data products, focusing on design principles that enhance data comprehension and drive user adoption.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Aesthetic and Design Acumen: Ability to translate complex analytical findings into beautiful, polished, and intuitive visualizations, evidenced by a strong public portfolio.
  • Technical Agility: Proficiency in the core Tech Stack, including Python, SQL, Posit Connect, Looker Studio, and Git.
  • Self-Direction and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a visualization portfolio autonomously, proactively identify and implement improvements, and take ownership of the data visualization layer.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively deal with technical ambiguities and continuously seek process improvements in data product delivery.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders and present complex data concepts clearly.


Requirements:

  • At least 1 year of hands-on experience working with Shiny for Python or similar interactive visualization frameworks such as Plotly, Dash, or Shiny for R , including building interactive dashboards and understanding core concepts like reactivity and UI/server architecture.
  • Expert BI Tool Experience: Strong, hands-on experience with Looker Studio, particularly in data blending, custom calculations, and connecting to various data sources.
  • Advanced SQL Skills: Demonstrated ability to write complex, performant SQL queries (using CTEs, window functions, and advanced joins) for data manipulation and preparation prior to visualization.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Familiarity with other data visualization libraries in Python (e.g., Plotly, Dash) to complement Shiny.
  • Experience with other BI platforms (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is a plus.
  • Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in a quantitative or technical field.
  • 3+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on data visualization development, BI reporting, or data product creation, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

title: Cloud Architecture Consultant (AWS – HIPAA)
description:
About You

You are a Cloud Architect who enjoys owning architectural decisions and designing secure, scalable, and compliant cloud solutions. You thrive in regulated environments and are comfortable balancing hands-on technical work with strategic thinking.   • Architect & document: Provide Azure target architecture (HLD/LLD), BoM pricing, licensing details, and clear TCO/ROI rationale.
  • Migrate & troubleshoot: Migrate on‑prem workloads to Azure; troubleshoot Azure/Windows issues across processor, networking, clusters, I/O, and memory.
  • Define end‑to‑end solutions: Realize solution architecture addressing business processes, regulatory needs, quality attributes, and cost efficiency.
  • Windows services expertise: Administer and troubleshoot Windows File/Print, DNS, WINS, DHCP, clustering, DFS; perform upgrades, backups, and restorations.
  • Team leadership: Govern and technically guide infra teams (5+ members); provide 24×7 support and work in shifts.
  • Stakeholder collaboration: Work with internal/customer stakeholders and PMs across banking, healthcare, and insurance domains; ensure risks are mitigated and lessons captured post‑project.


Must have skills:

  • Experience: 13+ years in IT; 5+ years in Azure Infra, Azure Migrate, Azure Networking (IaaS/PaaS), DC/Cloud/Security/SIAM/Data/Storage.
  • Azure services: Azure Key Vault, Azure IAM, Landing Zone design, BoM/pricing/licensing, TCO/ROI.
  • Windows administration: File/Print, DNS, WINS, DHCP, clustering, DFS; server consolidation, upgrades, backup/restore.
  • Migration & troubleshooting: On‑prem to Azure via Azure Migrate; deep troubleshooting in Azure & Windows environments.
  • Leadership & support: Team governance (5+), stakeholder management, 24×7 support readiness, shift flexibility.


Good to have:

  • Certifications: AZ‑305 (Designing Microsoft Azure Infrastructure Solutions), AZ‑104 (Microsoft Azure Administrator).
  • Design exposure: DR/business continuity, identity/governance/monitoring solutions; solution presentations and customer communication.

title: Tech Lead React
description:
Tech Lead | React Web

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.


Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.



Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?



Qual será o seu papel?

Você atuará como Tech Lead React Web, sendo a referência técnica do time e também alguém que trabalha de forma ativa no desenvolvimento. Seu papel envolve orientar a equipe, garantir a qualidade das entregas, apoiar decisões técnicas, participar de entrevistas, promover as melhores práticas de frontend e assegurar que processos, documentação e ritmo de evolução do time estejam sempre alinhados. Além de liderar, você colocará a mão na massa na construção de interfaces, criação de componentes escaláveis e manutenção de uma base sólida de frontend, contribuindo diretamente para a experiência do usuário e para a evolução contínua do projeto.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Alinhar e acompanhar objetivos do time, garantindo que os processos da Rethink sejam seguidos;
  • Acompanhar a evolução das tarefas ao longo do ciclo de desenvolvimento, identificando riscos para a entrega e atuando para mitigá-los;
  • Liderar o desenvolvimento web, criando componentes reutilizáveis e escaláveis com React, desenvolvendo interfaces responsivas e acessíveis, e colaborando com design e backend;
  • Identificar e resolver problemas de desempenho para manter interfaces rápidas e confiáveis;
  • Realizar revisões de código, orientar padrões e propor melhorias contínuas;
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) em tecnologias e boas práticas de frontend;
  • Atuar como a principal referência técnica para o time e para o cliente, apoiando decisões, direcionando soluções e garantindo alinhamento entre necessidades do projeto e capacidades da equipe;
  • Conduzir entrevistas e avaliar candidatos para compor o time de TI sob sua responsabilidade, assegurando que o perfil técnico e comportamental esteja aderente às necessidades do projeto;
  • Garantir que o time mantenha atualizadas as ferramentas e artefatos essenciais ao fluxo de trabalho, como Jira, documentações e registros de processo, preservando organização, histórico e visibilidade;
  • Identificar oportunidades de capacitação e necessidades de desenvolvimento do time, promovendo nivelamento técnico e incentivando uma evolução contínua e estruturada da equipe;
  • Apoiar o time de projetos na elaboração de cronogramas e estimativas, trazendo visão técnica para planejar entregas, dimensionar esforço e antecipar riscos;
  • Desenvolver, implementar e otimizar interfaces responsivas e acessíveis, aplicando boas práticas de UX/UI e garantindo uma experiência fluida, inclusiva e eficiente para o usuário;
  • Liderar o desenvolvimento web, guiando decisões técnicas, garantindo a adoção de boas práticas e assegurando que o produto avance com qualidade, consistência e escalabilidade.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Domínio no desenvolvimento frontend utilizando React e seu ecossistema (Redux, React Router, Context API etc.);
  • Experiência com HTML5, CSS3 e pré-processadores de CSS (ex: SASS, LESS);
  • Familiaridade com testes de frontend (ex: Jest, React Testing Library).
  • Familiaridade com conceitos de User Experience (UX) e User Interface (UI);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de versionamento de código, preferencialmente Git;
  • Conhecimento em prototipagem de interfaces utilizando Figma ou outras ferramentas de design;
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);
  • Experiência com integração de APIs RESTful, com práticas de DevOps e pipelines de CI/CD aplicadas ao frontend;
  • Proatividade, perfil comunicativo, resolução de problemas complexos e busca por melhoria contínua.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Tiver experiência com TypeScript;
  • Tiver experiência com gerenciamento de dependências usando NPM e/ou YARN;
  • Conhecer bibliotecas de UI como Material UI, Ant Design ou similares;
  • Aplicar práticas de acessibilidade seguindo diretrizes como WCAG;
  • Tiver vivência com integrações em nuvem (AWS ou outras plataformas);
  • Conhecer princípios de SEO aplicados a aplicações web;
  • Tiver experiência com arquitetura de projetos complexos.

Básico que a gente ama

Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Our purpose

The Content Specialist is an exciting role in ecoPortal’s marketing team, directly contributing to our content strategy. You’ll be part of a team with big aspirations, changing perceptions of health and safety worldwide.

  • Experience in managing Podcasts, Webinars and live content events.
  • The ability to meet deadlines, be a self-starter and have a can-do attitude.
  • Great communication skills, with the ability to liaise with both internal and external stakeholders regularly.


Key Responsibilities


  • Execution of the company’s content strategy, with the aim of educating, engaging, entertaining and empowering people across the company’s full customer lifecycle.

37-Hour Work Week & Flexible Working: We prioritise work-life balance by offering a 37-hour workweek and flexible working arrangements. Some of your working hours will be aligned with the New Zealand time zone to ensure collaboration with the team.


⛺️ Generous Annual Leave

End-of-Year Celebration: Enter the draw for a chance to join the team at ecoPortal HQ in New Zealand for our epic end-of-year celebrations! The longer you’ve been with eP, the more entries you get. We've got flights, accommodation, and meals all covered while you’re here. ✈️ ️

❤️

  • Develop, optimize, and maintain efficient, production-ready SQL queries, leveraging advanced techniques such as Common Table Expressions (CTEs) and window functions.
  • Actively manage the performance layer of data visualization products, ensuring both Shiny applications and Looker Studio reports execute quickly and maintain responsiveness under anticipated data volumes and user load.
  • Collaborate closely with Data Engineering teams to understand and leverage the underlying data warehouse structure (e.g., Python, SQL).
  • User Experience (UX) and Data Design
  • Translate complex, multi-dimensional datasets into clean, visually compelling, and intuitive user experiences, moving beyond simple table and chart outputs to sophisticated data narratives.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all data products, focusing on design principles that enhance data comprehension and drive user adoption.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Aesthetic and Design Acumen: Ability to translate complex analytical findings into beautiful, polished, and intuitive visualizations, evidenced by a strong public portfolio.
  • Technical Agility: Proficiency in the core Tech Stack, including Python, SQL, Posit Connect, Looker Studio, and Git.

  • At least 1 year of hands-on experience working with Shiny for Python or similar interactive visualization frameworks such as Plotly, Dash, or Shiny for R , including building interactive dashboards and understanding core concepts like reactivity and UI/server architecture.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in a quantitative or technical field.
  • 3+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on data visualization development, BI reporting, or data product creation, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment.

  • Health and wellness package.

title: Senior Cloud SRE
description:
Cloud Infrastructure SRE / Tier 4 Engineer

As a Cloud Infrastructure SRE / Tier 4 Engineer , you will join a specialized engineering task force dedicated to preventing and resolving the most critical and strategic customer issues encountered in the field.

Our global team of experienced engineers has a deep understanding of the lower layers of private cloud infrastructure. Together, we work on practical solutions, continuously learning and adapting. We collaborate closely, share knowledge, and tackle challenges head-on.

If you're an engineer eager to understand the core of cloud technologies and looking for a team that values hands-on expertise , you'll fit right in with us.


What you will learn and contribute to

  • Maintain and enhance Red Hat private cloud: You’ll work extensively with Nokia Container Services (NCS) and CloudBand Infrastructure Software (CBIS) , private cloud solutions based on Kubernetes and OpenStack .
  • Deep Dive Troubleshooting: Starting from high-level Kubernetes error messages, you’ll navigate through multiple layers until pinpointing issues—even down to kernel-level bugs.
  • Automate and Develop: Spend 30–50% of your time developing automation to prevent recurring issues. Solve it once, automate for the future. Use your Python skills to create health checks and improve reliability.
  • Continuous Learning: In our rapidly evolving tech landscape, ongoing learning is a cornerstone.
  • Collaborate with Developers and Engineers: Work closely with developers and product engineers to bridge infrastructure and software, ensuring seamless product delivery.
  • Mode of Operation: This role requires participation in a follow-the-sun scheme with 12-hour shifts (within regulatory limits) or participation in on-call rotations to ensure business continuity during emergencies.


Your skills and experience

  • Linux Expertise: Strong familiarity with Linux distributions; we primarily use Red Hat and CentOS .
  • Networking Foundations: Solid understanding of networking fundamentals (VLANs, IP routing). Experience with Calico , Multus , and Open vSwitch is a plus.
  • Problem-Solving Mindset: Excellent troubleshooting skills and analytical thinking to address complex challenges.
  • Scripting and Automation: Proficiency in Bash and Python , or willingness to learn, plus familiarity with Ansible .
  • Containerization & Virtualization: Knowledge of Podman , Kubernetes , Helm , and/or OpenStack ; experience with KVM/QEMU is advantageous.
  • Storage Systems: Experience with Ceph and Rook is highly valued.
  • Database Expertise: Understanding of relational databases (MySQL , MariaDB ) and experience with etcd .
  • Monitoring and Logging: Familiarity with tools like ELK (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) , Prometheus , and Grafana .
  • Advanced written and spoken English.


It would be nice if you also had

  • Proactive thinking and ownership mindset.
  • Strong focus on quality and reliability.

Job Purpose:

We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Product Designer to own the end-to-end user experience for our Carnegie Audiences suite of products (careerexplorer.com and supplemental products), including the integration and design of new Agentic AI interactions. You will be responsible for translating complex user needs and business goals into intuitive, elegant, and effective design solutions. This role requires a strong focus on core user experience, user flows, and wireframing, in addition to high-quality visual user interface (UI) execution.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • User Experience (UX) Strategy and Design
  • Lead the design process from initial concept and user research through to final implementation and iteration, focusing on complex user flows, information architecture, and system design.
  • Develop and refine wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups to communicate design intent and test hypotheses with users and stakeholders.
  • Conduct usability testing, analyze user data, and gather feedback to drive continuous improvement of the product experience.
  • Design and integrate Agentic AI experiences into product flows, ensuring a seamless, trustworthy, and effective interaction between the user and the AI system.
  • User Interface (UI) Design and Visual Execution
  • Create polished, high-fidelity visual designs and detailed design specifications that adhere to brand guidelines and accessibility standards.
  • Maintain and contribute to our existing Design System, ensuring consistency, scalability, and efficiency across all product touchpoints.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all product outputs, focusing on design principles that enhance clarity and drive user adoption.
  • Data Product Development
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate strategic requirements into data product features.
  • Direct the building and maintenance of data-centric applications and tools that leverage machine learning insights.
  • Implement and manage MLOps and CI/CD workflows for efficient model and data product deployments.
  • Ensure data governance, quality, and integrity across all analytical solutions.
  • Collaboration and Implementation
  • Partner closely with Product Managers to define product strategy and requirements, ensuring design solutions align with business objectives and technical constraints.
  • Collaborate with front-end engineers to ensure accurate design implementation and a seamless, high-quality user experience post-launch.
  • Participate in agile development processes, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and design critiques.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • UX/UI Acumen: Exceptional ability to translate strategic product goals into logical user flows and visually compelling, intuitive user interfaces, evidenced by a strong public portfolio of work on consumer-facing web products.
  • Technical Design Proficiency: Expertise in current design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD) for creating high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, and specifications.
  • Design Ownership and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a design portfolio autonomously, proactively identify design opportunities, and take ownership of the product’s end-to-end user experience.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively navigate complex design challenges and continuously seek elegant solutions that balance user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively present design rationale to non-technical stakeholders and facilitate productive design critiques.


Requirements:

  • Advanced Proficiency in UX Design: Deep expertise in the full lifecycle of UX design, including user research, wireframing, journey mapping, and developing interactive prototypes that demonstrate complex user flows.
  • Expert UI/Visual Design Experience: Strong, hands-on experience in high-fidelity visual design, typography, color theory, and creating/maintaining design systems for web products.
  • Consumer Web Focus: Demonstrated ability to design and launch successful consumer-facing products on the web.
  • Portfolio: Mandatory submission of a portfolio (e.g., personal website, Dribbble, GitHub) that clearly demonstrates a focus on design thinking, user flows, and high-end aesthetic execution for consumer web applications.


Nice-to-haves:

  • AI/ML Design: Experience designing user experiences for AI/ML-powered features or familiarity with the principles of Agentic AI.
  • Familiarity with motion design and animation principles to enhance user interactions.
  • Proficiency with front-end code (HTML, CSS, JavaScript frameworks) to facilitate better collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in Design, HCI, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on Product Design (UX/UI) for consumer-facing web applications, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

title: SAP Basis Analyst
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e carrega quase 30 anos de experiência por meio de suas companhias legadas, principalmente a partir da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants .

Iniciamos nossas operações no Brasil em 2007 como DISYS e, desde então, atendemos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, nos consolidamos como uma das maiores empresas de soluções e contratação em TI, entregando serviços que combinam escala global, portfólio completo e agilidade tática , apoiando a modernização de modelos de contratação, evolução de soluções de workforce e transformação tecnológica.

Possuímos escritórios em Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP) , mantendo proximidade com nossos clientes e consultores. Somos também uma Minority Owner Company , com forte compromisso com diversidade, inclusão e equidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro da nossa estratégia e representam nosso maior ativo. Nosso compromisso é atrair, desenvolver e reter talentos, criando conexões reais e duradouras.

Acreditamos que a combinação certa entre talento, tecnologia e organizações desbloqueia resultados transformadores e impulsiona o sucesso de clientes e consultores.

Nossos valores — Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia — orientam todas as nossas decisões.

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade. Nosso processo seletivo é inclusivo e aberto a profissionais de todas as identidades, experiências e trajetórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Você irá atuar em um cliente multinacional de grande porte , do setor de petróleo e gás.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar em Follow The Sun (FTS) no suporte a incidentes para todos os sistemas SAP, incluindo ambientes SAP RISE .
  • Garantir integridade, disponibilidade e controles das instâncias SAP em ambientes híbridos (on-prem + cloud).
  • Produzir relatórios e métricas para stakeholders, incluindo KPIs operacionais e SLAs de serviços em nuvem .
  • Coordenar atividades técnicas de grande porte que envolvam múltiplos times e ambientes SAP RISE e tradicionais.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times EMIT , SAP e hyperscalers (AWS, Azure) para restauração de serviços em incidentes críticos.
  • Analisar requisitos técnicos para onboarding SAP RISE e integração com ambientes cloud.
  • Criar, manter e evoluir documentação de padrões BASIS , incluindo arquiteturas SAP RISE e configurações específicas de cloud.
  • Construir e testar Proof of Concepts (PoCs) em ambientes SAP RISE e SAP BTP .
  • Executar atividades de administração de sistemas em:
  • SAP NetWeaver ABAP e JAVA
  • SAP S/4HANA
  • SAP HANA Database
  • Implementar e manter monitoramento e alertas utilizando:
  • SAP Solution Manager
  • SAP Focused Run
  • SAP Cloud ALM
  • Realizar atividades recorrentes de manutenção, como:
  • RFCs
  • Perfis SAP
  • Limpeza de file systems
  • Login groups e load balancing
  • Atuar como owner na análise e resolução de problemas de plataforma , utilizando práticas estruturadas de problem management.
  • Planejar e executar:
  • Upgrades de sistemas
  • Enhancement Packs
  • Atualizações de serviços em nuvem
  • Apoiar mudanças de infraestrutura, incluindo DB, SO e hardware , em ambientes híbridos.
  • Monitorar capacidade (CPU, disco, spool, memória) em sistemas on-prem e cloud.
  • Analisar e resolver problemas de performance , inclusive em ambientes SAP RISE.
  • Planejar e executar testes de Disaster Recovery e Cyber Recovery , incluindo cenários de failover em nuvem.
  • Responder a relatórios EarlyWatch e health checks específicos do SAP RISE .
  • Gerenciar jobs de housekeeping e scripts de automação.
  • Atuar em plantões rotativos (on-call) fora do horário comercial.
  • Construir e configurar sistemas SAP seguindo padrões corporativos, incluindo provisionamento e onboarding SAP RISE .


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida com SAP BASIS , incluindo:
  • SAP NetWeaver ABAP e JAVA
  • SAP Solution Manager
  • SAP Focused Run
  • SAP LaMa
  • Experiência com SAP HANA , incluindo administração e otimização.
  • Vivência com SAP RISE , incluindo:
  • Provisionamento em cloud
  • SLAs
  • Integração com hyperscalers
  • Experiência em ambientes híbridos SAP (on-premises + cloud).
  • Conhecimentos em SAP BTP e SAP Cloud ALM .
  • Experiência com scripts e automação (PowerShell, Shell Script).
  • Forte capacidade de troubleshooting , documentação e comunicação técnica.


Será um destaque seu perfil com

  • Experiência prévia em ambientes SAP de grande porte e alta criticidade.
  • Vivência com arquiteturas complexas e globais .
  • Experiência em automação e padronização de ambientes SAP.


Onde você vai trabalhar

No conforto da sua casa — regime 100% Home Office .

description:
