Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

  • Desenvolvedor Fullstack com boa experiência em Java, Python, AWS (AWS CloudFormation, AWS Lambda), JavaScript.
  • CLT, salário a combinar+ benefícios.
  • 100% remoto.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Scrum Master
description:
Senior Scrum Master - Customer Data Ecosystem

Brazil

Contract-to-hire


Job Description

You were made to do this work: designing new technologies, diving into data, optimizing digital experiences, and constantly developing better, faster ways to get results. You want to be part of a performance culture dedicated to building technology for a purpose that matters. Here, you’ll work in an environment that promotes sustainability, inclusion, wellbeing, and career development while you help us deliver better care for billions of people around the world. It starts with YOU.


In this role, you will:

  • Facilitate daily stand-ups, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives for the customer data ecosystem teams
  • Remove obstacles and impediments that hinder the team’s progress, ensuring smooth and efficient workflows.
  • Coach the team on Agile principles and practices, ensuring adherence to Scrum frameworks.
  • Collaborate with product owners to manage the product backlog and ensure clear communication of requirements.
  • Track team performance metrics, such as velocity and burndown, and work to improve productivity and efficiency.
  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement within the team, encouraging the adoption of Agile best practices.
  • Foster a collaborative environment where team members feel empowered to contribute and innovate.
  • Work with legal and compliance teams to ensure that all sprints consider data privacy and regulatory requirements.
  • Facilitate the integration of compliance requirements into the agile development process.
  • Lead efforts to align Scrum practices with the organization’s digital marketing strategy and goals.
  • Provide guidance on managing dependencies between teams and coordinating cross-team collaboration.
  • Stay current with industry trends in Agile methodologies, applying relevant advancements to improve team performance.
  • Ensure that the team’s work is aligned with business objectives, delivering value to the organization.
  • Provide training and mentoring to team members and other Scrum Masters within the organization.
  • Lead efforts to resolve conflicts and challenges within the team, ensuring a positive and productive work environment.
  • Drive Change Management through coaching the team and support them on the Transformation journey by establishing clear processes and challenging them on shifting mindset
  • Oversee the integration and use of Azure Dev Ops tools within project teams to optimize collaboration, code management, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Drive the adoption of Azure DevOps features among the team, ensuring they are leveraged to enhance project transparency and delivery efficiency

title: Azure / Windows Architect
description:

This is a high-impact role within a global consumer goods company, focused on modernizing digital brand experiences through MACH architecture and cloud-native solutions. The digital team is transitioning legacy platforms to composable, API-first environments to improve speed, performance, and personalization. Collaboration across marketing, legal, compliance, and engineering functions is essential to align technical architecture with business goals and regulatory standards. Foco em recrutamento estratégico e com entrega rápida/efetiva. Nosso SLA de entrega são 5 dias úteis, e nossa taxa de fechamento é entre 3 - 6 indicados.


Perfil

  • Altamente organizado e orientado a resultados
  • Excelente comunicação interpessoal
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades em ritmo acelerado
  • Resiliência à pressão e postura hands-on
  • Curioso: Nosso perfil é pesquisar sobre vagas, criar estratégias de hunting ground, conseguir ter base para entrevistar candidatos de forma qualificada.
  • Somos uma empresa jovem, com cultura dinâmica, rápida, e anti-burocrática. Se você se identifica com essa linha, será bem-vindo.


Infraestrutura

  • Computador próprio e conexão de internet estável


O que não se alinha com o nosso jeito de trabalhar

  • Dificuldade em lidar com ritmo intenso e alta pressão: Nosso dia a dia é acelerado e está em constante transformação. Quem precisa de supervisão constante, tem dificuldade com pressão ou busca um ambiente previsível pode não se adaptar bem aqui.
  • Ausência de senso de responsabilidade e rejeição à autonomia: Esperamos postura de dono: tomar decisões, assumir riscos e gerar resultados. Quem depende de orientação constante ou busca validação o tempo todo provavelmente não terá espaço. Aqui, o protagonismo é essencial e valorizado com participação nos resultados.
  • Resistência a feedbacks francos e cultura de transparência: Prezamos pela clareza e sinceridade. Feedbacks são recorrentes e parte do nosso desenvolvimento. Isso exige maturidade para aceitar críticas construtivas com abertura e humildade.
  • Apego a horários fixos: Somos uma consultoria em expansão acelerada. Problemas surgem a qualquer momento, e as soluções também. Valorizamos quem entrega com excelência mesmo que isso demande flexibilidade de agenda.


Pacote de remuneração

title: Data Visualization Specialist
description:
About the Product:

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Role Summary:

We are looking for a technical builder to own our data visualization layer. You will develop custom, interactive data products for our customers using Shiny for Python and maintain rapid internal reporting using Looker Studio.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Data Visualization Product Development (Shiny for Python)
  • Architect, build, and deploy production-grade, highly-interactive data applications for customer-facing delivery using the Shiny for Python framework.
  • Lead the full development lifecycle, encompassing the design of intuitive user interfaces (UI) and the implementation of robust, performant server-side logic and reactivity.
  • Implement best practices for code quality, testing, modularization (e.g., Shiny modules), and deployment on platforms like Posit Connect to ensure a reliable and scalable data product experience.
  • Business Intelligence and Internal Reporting Management
  • Serve as the owner and subject matter expert for the internal Business Intelligence environment, primarily utilizing Looker Studio.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated dashboards and reports that deliver timely and actionable insights to internal stakeholders, effectively replacing manual reporting processes.
  • Apply advanced BI techniques, including the creation of complex calculated fields and data blending, to integrate diverse datasets for a unified view of performance.
  • Data Querying and Performance Optimization
  • Develop, optimize, and maintain efficient, production-ready SQL queries, leveraging advanced techniques such as Common Table Expressions (CTEs) and window functions.
  • Actively manage the performance layer of data visualization products, ensuring both Shiny applications and Looker Studio reports execute quickly and maintain responsiveness under anticipated data volumes and user load.
  • Collaborate closely with Data Engineering teams to understand and leverage the underlying data warehouse structure (e.g., Python, SQL).
  • User Experience (UX) and Data Design
  • Translate complex, multi-dimensional datasets into clean, visually compelling, and intuitive user experiences, moving beyond simple table and chart outputs to sophisticated data narratives.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all data products, focusing on design principles that enhance data comprehension and drive user adoption.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Aesthetic and Design Acumen: Ability to translate complex analytical findings into beautiful, polished, and intuitive visualizations, evidenced by a strong public portfolio.
  • Technical Agility: Proficiency in the core Tech Stack, including Python, SQL, Posit Connect, Looker Studio, and Git.
  • Self-Direction and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a visualization portfolio autonomously, proactively identify and implement improvements, and take ownership of the data visualization layer.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively deal with technical ambiguities and continuously seek process improvements in data product delivery.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders and present complex data concepts clearly.


Requirements:

  • At least 1 year of hands-on experience working with Shiny for Python or similar interactive visualization frameworks such as Plotly, Dash, or Shiny for R , including building interactive dashboards and understanding core concepts like reactivity and UI/server architecture.
  • Expert BI Tool Experience: Strong, hands-on experience with Looker Studio, particularly in data blending, custom calculations, and connecting to various data sources.
  • Advanced SQL Skills: Demonstrated ability to write complex, performant SQL queries (using CTEs, window functions, and advanced joins) for data manipulation and preparation prior to visualization.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Familiarity with other data visualization libraries in Python (e.g., Plotly, Dash) to complement Shiny.
  • Experience with other BI platforms (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is a plus.
  • Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in a quantitative or technical field.
  • 3+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on data visualization development, BI reporting, or data product creation, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

Project Description:

Founded in 1984, our client is one of the world's leading provider of lithography systems for the semiconductor industry, manufacturing complex machines that are critical to the production of integrated circuits or chips. The client has its R&D and manufacturing operations in The Netherlands.

Luxoft is currently searching to augment the Development & Engineering Department with a talented software engineer to design and implement embedded software for systems among the highest precision ever produced in the world.


Responsibilities:

  • As a software engineer, you will be working on Linux server applications for metrology components and on complex algorithms application software. You will be working with electrical engineers, mechatronic engineers and system engineers to define the software requirements.
  • A team of about 10 people consisting of a team lead, a sw architect, a few senior developers. After your SW design is approved you are responsible for implementing the design in Python & C for new modules.
  • During testing, you will collect the necessary data so you can write a test report.
  • The development environment is Red Hat Linux, execution environment is Wind River Linux. The software release driving a client machine is 40 million lines of code. Client SW teams work in various modes such as Agile and SAFE.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • We are looking for colleagues with at least 5 years of development experience.
  • Python: application coding
  • Linux (one of more of the following): familiar with command line tools, makefile, git, shell and python scripting
  • Embedded C and C++: understanding and maintaining legacy code. Adding new features while keeping compliance with established architecture.
  • Version control using command line is also required - Git, Clear Case and SVN, in this order of priority.


Languages:

  • English: C1 Advanced

title: Senior Software Engineer – Frontend (ReactJS / Svelte)
description:
Job Title: Senior Software Engineer – Frontend (ReactJS / Svelte)

Location: Remote

Overview:

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Frontend Engineer with expertise in ReactJS and/or Svelte to join our team. You will collaborate closely with Product, QA, and Backend teams to deliver a world-class user experience to millions of users across web and OTT platforms.

Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with Product, QA, and Backend teams to design and deliver engaging, high-quality user experiences.
  • Design and implement features with robustness, anticipating failures and edge cases.
  • Maintain detailed documentation of features, workflows, and processes.
  • Communicate progress effectively through Jira, Slack, and Confluence.
  • Develop applications for a variety of OTT devices including Set Top Boxes, Connected TVs (LG webOS, Samsung Tizen, Vizio SmartCast, Hisense Vidaa), and gaming consoles (PS4, PS5, Xbox One).
  • Take ownership and responsibility for your work, including code quality and feature delivery.
  • Participate in code reviews, providing and receiving constructive feedback.
  • Thrive in a fast-paced agile development environment.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum 5 years of professional software development experience.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience developing web applications using ReactJS and/or Svelte.
  • Strong experience integrating REST APIs and rapidly learning new APIs/SDKs.
  • At least 1 year of Typescript development experience.
  • Experience working with build tools like Nx, Rspack, Vite, Webpack.
  • Proven experience in developing and supporting high-traffic consumer or business applications.

Preferred / “Nice-to-Have” Skills:

  • Experience building high-performance applications for low-resource devices.
  • Experience in streaming video application development.
  • Knowledge of OTT, Connected TV, Smart TV, or Embedded Device app development.
  • Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills.
  • Deep understanding of web browser rendering and UI performance optimization.
  • Experience implementing and troubleshooting frontend analytics.

What We Offer:

  • Opportunity to work on large-scale, high-impact applications used by millions.
  • Collaborative, fast-paced environment with a focus on innovation.
  • Exposure to cutting-edge OTT and Connected TV technologies.

title: Remote Data Scientist (ML) - 52621
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We’re looking for a Data Scientist who has excellent hands on Python skills and Machine Learning experience — someone who lives and breathes code, optimizes for performance, and has proven mastery on competitive programming or data challenge platforms like LeetCode, Codeforces, HackerRank, or Kaggle . In this role you will be working with Turing team members and AI researchers at Frontier Labs to devise techniques and build data sets to improve performance of models.


What You’ll Do:

  • Build, test, and optimize high-performance Python systems used in large-scale AI and data pipelines.
  • Design and maintain modular, clean, and production-ready Python codebases.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (data, infra, and research engineers) to deliver reliable backend components.
  • Write efficient, maintainable, and testable code with strong focus on algorithms and data structures .
  • Stay current with modern Python tools, frameworks, ML advancements and best practices.


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of professional experience writing Python in production environments.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Python and core libraries (Pandas, NumPy, AsyncIO, Pytorch, Transformers, or similar).
  • Proven track record on coding platforms — e.g., top percentile or strong rating on LeetCode, Codeforces, HackerRank, or Kaggle competitions.
  • Experience with system design, clean architecture, and performance optimization.
  • Working level Proficiency in either Machine Learning or Data Science for Machine Learning.


Bonus:

  • Recognized performance in Kaggle , Codeforces , or ICPC/TopCoder contests.
  • Deep curiosity for performance tuning, scalability, and elegant code design.


Perks of Freelancing with Turing:

  • Work fully remotely, from anywhere.
  • Collaborate with world-class AI labs and frontier research companies .
  • Tackle real engineering challenges with high autonomy and ownership.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment: Minimum 20 hours/week with 4-hour PST overlap (options: 20, 30, or 40 hrs/week).
  • Type: Contractor (no medical/paid leave).
  • Duration: 3 months (start date: next week).


Evaluation Process:

  • Technical Interview (60 mins): discussion of Python problem-solving, architecture, and system design.


After applying, you’ll receive a login link by email. Please complete your profile promptly so we can proceed with your application.


We’re actively hiring for this role. If you know exceptional talent, please refer them at turing.com/referrals and earn money for successful referrals.

title: Senior Revenue Operations Associate
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About SpendHound:

  • SpendHound is a 100% free software renewal management platform and service recently launched by the research firm YipitData. (See this introductory video from SpendHound’s Senior Product Manager!)
  • SpendHound is the single source of truth for companies’ renewal information and includes:
  • A comprehensive view of all software applications used with annual contract values, auto-renewal information, renewal dates, license counts, and more
  • An invoice and contract management system for companies to store their invoices and contracts
  • Renewal reminders through email and Slack so companies never miss upcoming software renewals
  • Free advice from procurement experts to discuss price benchmarking insights and negotiation strategies for any upcoming renewals
  • Companies use the SpendHound platform and procurement expert service to save time and money on their software renewals.
  • SpendHound is free for customers because customer data is de-identified, aggregated with other panelists, and used as part of YipitData market research (example report ).


About The Role:

Are you a collaborative consulting, analytics, or operations professional with 5+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team?

We are seeking a Sr. Revenue Operations Associate to play a crucial role in our fast-growing team, SpendHound. As a fast-growing “start-up” within a larger organization, this is a unique opportunity for someone with a strong operational mindset to come in and help build something truly special.


We expect East work hours.


As our Senior Revenue Operations Associate, you will partner with our Sales and Marketing teams to:

  • Be an operations subject matter expert for the Sales function, working closely with RevOps and Spendhound leadership to support Sales and execute on key initiatives
  • Implement processes and solutions that can streamline revenue acquisition and eliminate inefficiencies
  • Maintain and measure various components of the Sales process, such as
  • Target/Territory Management
  • Lead Generation and Outbound Cadence Operations.
  • Ensure that the Sales teams are operating seamlessly through data evaluation and by improving workflows


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • Operations professional with 5+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team.
  • You demonstrate a high aptitude for organization, process development, project and change management, and analytics
  • You have advanced Excel skills
  • Your experience with CRMs such as Salesforce.com
  • You are willing to become proficient in SQL and data management
  • You are a natural problem-solver, with a keen eye for detail and spotting issues
  • You are committed to continuously improving yourself and helping those around you


What We Offer:

  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

title: SAP Basis Analyst
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e carrega quase 30 anos de experiência por meio de suas companhias legadas, principalmente a partir da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants .

Iniciamos nossas operações no Brasil em 2007 como DISYS e, desde então, atendemos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, nos consolidamos como uma das maiores empresas de soluções e contratação em TI, entregando serviços que combinam escala global, portfólio completo e agilidade tática , apoiando a modernização de modelos de contratação, evolução de soluções de workforce e transformação tecnológica.

Possuímos escritórios em Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP) , mantendo proximidade com nossos clientes e consultores. Somos também uma Minority Owner Company , com forte compromisso com diversidade, inclusão e equidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro da nossa estratégia e representam nosso maior ativo. Nosso compromisso é atrair, desenvolver e reter talentos, criando conexões reais e duradouras.

Acreditamos que a combinação certa entre talento, tecnologia e organizações desbloqueia resultados transformadores e impulsiona o sucesso de clientes e consultores.

Nossos valores — Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia — orientam todas as nossas decisões.

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade. Nosso processo seletivo é inclusivo e aberto a profissionais de todas as identidades, experiências e trajetórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Você irá atuar em um cliente multinacional de grande porte , do setor de petróleo e gás.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar em Follow The Sun (FTS) no suporte a incidentes para todos os sistemas SAP, incluindo ambientes SAP RISE .
  • Garantir integridade, disponibilidade e controles das instâncias SAP em ambientes híbridos (on-prem + cloud).
  • Produzir relatórios e métricas para stakeholders, incluindo KPIs operacionais e SLAs de serviços em nuvem .
  • Coordenar atividades técnicas de grande porte que envolvam múltiplos times e ambientes SAP RISE e tradicionais.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times EMIT , SAP e hyperscalers (AWS, Azure) para restauração de serviços em incidentes críticos.
  • Analisar requisitos técnicos para onboarding SAP RISE e integração com ambientes cloud.
  • Criar, manter e evoluir documentação de padrões BASIS , incluindo arquiteturas SAP RISE e configurações específicas de cloud.
  • Construir e testar Proof of Concepts (PoCs) em ambientes SAP RISE e SAP BTP .
  • Executar atividades de administração de sistemas em:
  • SAP NetWeaver ABAP e JAVA
  • SAP S/4HANA
  • SAP HANA Database
  • Implementar e manter monitoramento e alertas utilizando:
  • SAP Solution Manager
  • SAP Focused Run
  • SAP Cloud ALM
  • Realizar atividades recorrentes de manutenção, como:
  • RFCs
  • Perfis SAP
  • Limpeza de file systems
  • Login groups e load balancing
  • Atuar como owner na análise e resolução de problemas de plataforma , utilizando práticas estruturadas de problem management.
  • Planejar e executar:
  • Upgrades de sistemas
  • Enhancement Packs
  • Atualizações de serviços em nuvem
  • Apoiar mudanças de infraestrutura, incluindo DB, SO e hardware , em ambientes híbridos.
  • Monitorar capacidade (CPU, disco, spool, memória) em sistemas on-prem e cloud.
  • Analisar e resolver problemas de performance , inclusive em ambientes SAP RISE.
  • Planejar e executar testes de Disaster Recovery e Cyber Recovery , incluindo cenários de failover em nuvem.
  • Responder a relatórios EarlyWatch e health checks específicos do SAP RISE .
  • Gerenciar jobs de housekeeping e scripts de automação.
  • Atuar em plantões rotativos (on-call) fora do horário comercial.
  • Construir e configurar sistemas SAP seguindo padrões corporativos, incluindo provisionamento e onboarding SAP RISE .


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida com SAP BASIS , incluindo:
  • SAP NetWeaver ABAP e JAVA
  • SAP Solution Manager
  • SAP Focused Run
  • SAP LaMa
  • Experiência com SAP HANA , incluindo administração e otimização.
  • Vivência com SAP RISE , incluindo:
  • Provisionamento em cloud
  • SLAs
  • Integração com hyperscalers
  • Experiência em ambientes híbridos SAP (on-premises + cloud).
  • Conhecimentos em SAP BTP e SAP Cloud ALM .
  • Experiência com scripts e automação (PowerShell, Shell Script).
  • Forte capacidade de troubleshooting , documentação e comunicação técnica.


Será um destaque seu perfil com

  • Experiência prévia em ambientes SAP de grande porte e alta criticidade.
  • Vivência com arquiteturas complexas e globais .
  • Experiência em automação e padronização de ambientes SAP.


Onde você vai trabalhar

No conforto da sua casa — regime 100% Home Office .

title: Data Engineer
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.



About the opportunity:

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Data Engineer with deep expertise in MLOps discipline to join our Data Engineering team. In this role, you will be at the forefront of

designing and developing scalable, robust data architectures and MLOps solutions utilizing the latest technologies from Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and AWS. As a key contributor,

you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to understand and address their data and ML platform requirements.


Skills/Experience:

Minimum Requirements:

• At least 5 years of proven experience as a Data Engineer or MLOps Engineer in developing platform level capabilities for a data-driven midsize to large corporations.

• Strong programming skills in languages such as Python, Java or Scala, with experience building large-scale, fault-tolerant systems.

• Experience with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, AZURE) with strong preference to GCP.

• Experience with BigQuery or similar (Redshift, Snowflake, other MPP databases)

• Hands-on experience with ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch) and ML deployment patterns.

• Practical experience with containerization and orchestration tools (Docker, Kubernetes)

• Experience building data pipelines & ETL

• Experience with command line, version control software (git)

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

• Ability to work independently and quickly become productive after joining.

Preferred Requirements:

• Knowledge of distributed data processing frameworks such as Apache Kafka, Flink, Spark, or similar.

• Experience with DBT (Data Build Tool) and Looker.

• Knowledge of common ML deployment patterns.

Degree Requirements:

Bachelors or Masters Degree in Computer Science or relate

The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. title: SDR - Representante de Desenvolvimento de Vendas (Tech)
description:
SDR (Sales Development Representative) - TECH


Modelo: PJ

Local: Híbrido (2x por semana presencial Barra Funda - São Paulo)

Horário: Comercial

Reporte direto: Diretor Comercial / Head Comercial

Remuneração: R$2.000,00 (Fixo) + R$250,00 (Ajuda de Custo) + Comissão Agressiva


Responsabilidades:


  • Prospecção ativa B2B (Outbound) por LinkedIn, e-mail, WhatsApp e telefone .
  • Mapear e montar listas de contas e contatos (segmentação por setor, porte, região e tipo de dor).
  • Pesquisar empresas e entender sinais de oportunidade (crescimento, contratações, projetos, troca de ERP, expansão, etc.).
  • Identificar e abordar decisores (TI, Operações, Financeiro, RH, Diretores).
  • Qualificar leads com base em critérios definidos (ex.: perfil, dor, timing, budget, maturidade e prioridade).
  • Agendar reuniões para os vendedores e garantir passagem de bastão bem feita (contexto, dores, stakeholders, próximos passos).
  • Manter CRM atualizado com histórico e etapas (Pipedrive ou similar).
  • Rodar cadência de contatos (follow-ups) com consistência e organização.
  • Trabalhar junto com marketing para melhorar mensagens, materiais e campanhas.
  • Acompanhar métricas e gerar relatório semanal do funil (atividades, respostas, reuniões, conversões).


O que buscamos:


Obrigatório:

  • Experiência como SDR/BDR em B2B (idealmente em tecnologia, serviços ou consultoria).
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita (clareza, objetividade e ritmo).
  • Disciplina e consistência com rotina de cadência e CRM.
  • Capacidade de lidar com rejeição e manter performance.


Diferenciais:

  • Já ter vendido/gerado leads para: software house, squads/células, BI, integrações, cloud/DevOps, ERP, IA.
  • Ter atuado com ICP por segmentos (saúde, agro, indústria, varejo etc.).
  • Experiência com ferramentas: LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo/Lusha, HubSpot/Pipedrive, automações de e-mail, WhatsApp.


Perfil Comportamental:

  • “Dono do número”: forte senso de meta e responsabilidade.
  • Curioso e investigativo (pesquisa bem antes de falar com o lead).
  • Energia alta com postura profissional.
  • Organizado e consistente (sem perder follow-up).


Metas e Métricas:

  • Atividades/dia: 60–120 toques (multicanal).
  • Reuniões qualificadas/semana: 6–12 (ajustável pelo nicho).
  • Taxa de resposta: 8–15% (variável por campanha).
  • Taxa show-up: acima de 70%.
  • Taxa de qualificação: acima de 50% das reuniões geradas.


Remuneração:

  • Fixo + ajuda de custo + variável agressivo por reuniões qualificadas e/ou oportunidades geradas.
  • Bônus por bater meta mensal e por qualidade (ex.: reunião com decisor, fit forte, dor clara).


O que você vai encontrar aqui:

  • Produto/serviço com entrega real (time técnico forte).
  • Processo comercial em estruturação com espaço para crescer rápido.
  • Possibilidade real de virar Closer/Executivo de Vendas conforme performance.

title: Financial Controller
description:
Join a team that values you. At StaffRight, we connect talented professionals with global opportunities—and we’re growing fast! With competitive pay, health insurance, paid time off (including national holidays), and a supportive HR team always in your corner, you’ll love building your career with us.


The Controller is a hands-on, strategic finance leader responsible for overseeing all accounting operations across the company. This role ensures accurate financial reporting, strong internal controls, and scalable processes to support a growing, multi-brand food business.


The Controller partners closely with leadership to provide financial insights, manage cash flow, and support operational decision-making in a fast-moving CPG environment. This role is ideal for someone who is detail-oriented, highly organized, and comfortable operating at both the transactional and strategic levels.


This role is open to all candidates in the Philippines and all over Latin America.


What You’ll Be Doing:


Financial Accounting & Reporting

  • Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close process for all entities
  • Prepare and review timely and accurate financial statements including P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow
  • Ensure proper revenue recognition, inventory accounting, COGS, and accruals
  • Maintain and enforce consistent accounting policies and procedures
  • Manage the chart of accounts and general ledger structure to support brand-level and customer-level analysis


Inventory, Costing & Manufacturing Finance

  • Oversee inventory accounting for raw materials, work-in-process, and finished goods
  • Ensure accurate standard costing and variance analysis across materials, labor, and overhead
  • Partner with Operations to reconcile production, yields, and inventory movements
  • Drive accuracy and functionality of ERP systems, including Katana
  • Monitor and analyze margins by SKU, customer, and sales channel


Cash Flow, AP/AR & Controls

  • Manage cash flow forecasting and short- and medium-term liquidity planning
  • Oversee accounts payable and accounts receivable processes
  • Improve working capital efficiency including inventory turns, DSO, and DPO
  • Implement and maintain strong internal controls and approval workflows
  • Manage vendor payments, ACH and check processes, and banking relationships


Systems, Process & Scale

  • Own and optimize accounting systems and integrations including QuickBooks, ERP (Katana), and bill-pay tools
  • Improve automation, documentation, and repeatable finance processes
  • Prepare the finance function for audit readiness and future growth
  • Partner on system upgrades, implementations, and reporting enhancements


Compliance & External Relationships

  • Ensure compliance with GAAP and applicable tax and regulatory requirements
  • Coordinate with external CPA firms on tax filings, reviews, and audits
  • Support state and federal reporting requirements as applicable
  • Assist with insurance, sales tax, and other compliance areas


Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Manage and develop accounting staff or external resources as the business grows
  • Partner with Sales, Operations, and Supply Chain to provide financial insights
  • Deliver clear financial analysis to support pricing, promotions, and customer strategy
  • Act as a trusted financial thought partner to the CEO and leadership team


What We’re Looking For:


  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • CPA preferred but not required
  • 7+ years of progressive accounting or finance experience
  • Experience in CPG, food and beverage, manufacturing, or inventory-heavy businesses strongly preferred
  • Strong understanding of inventory accounting, costing, and margin analysis
  • Hands-on experience with QuickBooks and ERP systems
  • Katana experience is a strong plus
  • Proven ability to build and scale processes in a growing or entrepreneurial environment
  • Available to work in US time zones (Graveyard shift in the Philippines)
  • Available to start within 2 weeks from job offer


Technical Requirements:

  • Comfortable in using time-trackers (e.g. Time Doctor)
  • Own laptop/desktop, noise-cancelling headphones, and webcam
  • Reliable internet connection (at least 50 Mbps)
  • Available backup equipment in cases of power and internet outages
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and Google Workspace


Why You’ll Love Working Here:

Competitive Compensation

We offer a monthly salary based on your experience and qualifications. This is a full-time role requiring a 40-hour work week, and we make sure your expertise is valued and your contributions are fairly rewarded.


✈️ Paid Time Off and Sick Leave:

We believe in work-life balance. Enjoy generous paid time off and sick leave policies, allowing you to recharge, travel, or rest when needed—all while knowing your role is secure.

title: Técnico de implantação III
description:
A Convergint é uma empresa global, fundada em 2001 nos arredores de Chicago, que atua como integradora de sistemas especializada em segurança eletrônica, automação predial, áudio e vídeo, sistemas de incêndio e life safety, com objetivo de ser o melhor provedor de serviços para os nossos clientes.


Atualmente, contamos com mais de 11 mil colaboradores e estamos presentes em mais de 225 escritórios ao redor do mundo.


Estamos em busca de um(a) Técnico(a) de Implantação III para atuar na implantação, instalação, configuração e manutenção de sistemas e equipamentos técnicos , contribuindo diretamente para a execução de projetos em campo. O(a) profissional será responsável por realizar montagens, testes funcionais, integrações de sistemas e comissionamentos, garantindo o correto funcionamento das soluções implantadas.


Principais atividades:


1. Montagem de Quadros e Painéis

- Montagem, organização e fixação de componentes em quadros/painéis elétricos e de automação.

- Crimpagem, organização de chicotes e montagem seguindo padrões técnicos.

- Instalação de fontes, disjuntores, switches, controladores, relés, sensores e módulos de comunicação.

- Etiquetagem e identificação padronizada de cabos e dispositivos.


2. Leitura e Interpretação de Diagramas

- Interpretação de diagramas elétricos, diagramas de comando, diagramas multifilares e unifilares.

- Leitura de diagramas de interligação entre dispositivos e topologias de rede.

- Conhecimento de simbologia técnica conforme normas.


3. Cabeamento Estruturado

- Instalação, passagem e organização de cabos UTP/FTP conforme normas de cabeamento

estruturado (EIA/TIA).

- Conectorização e montagem de patch panels, keystones e racks.

- Certificação de link e testes de continuidade, interferência e performance.

- Boas práticas de organização, curvas, raio de dobra, rotulagem e acabamento.


4. Fibra Óptica

- Passagem e instalação de cabos ópticos (internos ou externos).

- Conectorização (fusões) e montagem de DIOs (Distribuidores Internos Ópticos).

- Testes com OTDR e power meter para validar perda e integridade.

- Identificação de rompimentos, falhas e degradação de sinal.

- Boas práticas de manipulação e segurança para fibra.


Formação:


  • Tecnologia da Informação;
  • Engenharia;
  • Sistemas de Informação;
  • Ciência da Computação;
  • Redes;
  • Automação ou áreas correlatas.

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
We Are Sportingtech :


Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world. Our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base.


Who are You ?


You are relentlessly committed to delivering exceptional partner support, combining deep technical knowledge with sharp analytical skills to resolve issues efficiently and prevent them from recurring. You excel at interpreting data, logs, and system behavior to uncover root causes and provide clear, actionable insights to both partners and internal teams.


A confident and influential communicator, you build strong relationships with operators, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams. You thrive on translating complex technical details into understandable guidance, ensuring that partners always feel supported and informed.


Where you Fit In:


We are seeking a proactive and technically strong B2B Technical Support Specialist to join our growing team. In this role, you will leverage your deep understanding of the iGaming industry and your strong analytical mindset to troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve issues reported by our operators and internal stakeholders.


Working closely with the ITSM department — and reporting directly to the Technical Support Team Lead — you will be a key player in ensuring high-quality, timely support. Your ability to interpret logs, analyze platform behavior, communicate clearly, and escalate effectively will help maintain platform reliability and deliver an exceptional partner experience.


You will thrive in a fast-paced environment where attention to detail, technical curiosity, and a commitment to service excellence are essential. Your work will be pivotal in strengthening partner trust, improving operational stability, and supporting our mission to deliver a seamless and compliant gaming experience worldwide.


The impact you will have:


  • Act as the primary technical point of contact for B2B operators, platform partners, and integrators, ensuring their issues are resolved quickly, accurately, and with minimal business impact.
  • Perform in-depth technical troubleshooting across game integrations, wallet systems, API calls, transaction flows, and platform services — using logs, monitoring tools, and diagnostics to identify root causes.
  • Identify, flag, and track repetitive issues or recurring error patterns, escalating them with clear technical context to drive permanent fixes.
  • Ensure all partner interactions, escalations, and resolutions align with regulatory requirements, internal controls, and jurisdictional rules — maintaining strong compliance awareness at all times.
  • Coordinate cross-team escalations ensuring that complex issues are escalated and documented clearly and progressed efficiently.
  • Stay current with industry standards, emerging technologies, and best practices across iGaming, payments, and platform operations, recommending improvements to processes and tooling.
  • Champion adoption of shared support frameworks — authoring playbooks, SLA policies, runbooks, and knowledge-base articles to standardize excellence across the organization.


What we’re looking for:


  • Experience in B2B Technical Support within the Casino or iGaming sector.
  • Strong understanding of iGaming systems such as game aggregation, wallet services, RNG, bonus engines, player tracking, and jurisdictional compliance.
  • Experience working with logs, monitoring tools, and debugging complex integration issues.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple cases, partners, and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Excellent English communication and presentation skills.
  • Hands-on experience with common support tooling (ex: Jira, Grafana, Kibana, etc.).


This role is remote and based in Brazil.


Sportingtech is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to providing a work environment of mutual respect to everyone without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

title: Global Guest Experience Coordinator
description:
Job Title: Global Guest Experience Coordinator

Location: Remote – Sao Paulo, Brazil

Department: Guest Experience

Working hours: Shifts range from 6 a.m. to 2 a.m., with 8-hour shifts. You will work 5 days out of 7 , including weekends depending on the rota.


Reports To: Head of Global Guest Experience / Global Guest Experience Manager


About Us

QIG is a dynamic group comprising three companies:

  • Q Global Network (QGN): A global serviced apartment agency working with suppliers around the world.
  • Aeria Apartments: A London-based serviced apartment provider.
  • QDK: Q Apartments Denmark, offering stress-free beginnings in and around Copenhagen


Together, we provide premium, fully furnished apartments for business and leisure travellers worldwide. Our mission is to deliver a seamless “home away from home” experience with unparalleled service, comfort, and convenience.


Although this position focuses on QDK, there is close cross-team collaboration across all three companies’ Guest Experience teams, ensuring we share knowledge, best practices, and consistently deliver exceptional service to both guests and suppliers.


Role Overv iew

The Global Guest Experience Coordinator is responsible for delivering a seamless, high-quality guest journey from pre-arrival to check-out, acting as the main point of contact for guest communication and support. The role combines exceptional customer service with effective problem-solving, ensuring issues are handled quickly, empathetically, and professionally.


Working closely with internal teams (including reservations, sales, operations, supply, and finance) and external partners such as approved suppliers, landlords, and managing agents worldwide, you will coordinate services, manage escalations, and help maintain consistent standards across the guest experience. You will also gather and analyse guest feedback, monitor partner performance, and contribute ideas to continuously improve service delivery—particularly for VIP and corporate accounts where attention to detail and discretion are essential.


Key Responsibilities

Guest Experience

  • Be the main point of contact for guests, responding to inquiries by email, phone, and live chat with professionalism and warmth.
  • Guide guests through the full journey—from pre-arrival checks to check-out—ensuring they feel supported at every stage.
  • Manage guest issues with empathy and efficiency, escalating only when necessary.


Complaint Resolution & Escalation Management:

  • Liaise daily with internal department like reservations, sales and operational team as well as approved suppliers, landlords, and managing agents across the globe to ensure smooth delivery of services.
  • Communicate guest feedback and issues to suppliers clearly, ensuring timely action.
  • Build and maintain strong, positive relationships with suppliers to foster trust and collaboration.
  • Monitor supplier performance and suggest improvements to strengthen our product.


Cross-Functional Collaboration:

  • Balance guest needs with operational & supplier capabilities to create win–win outcomes.
  • Anticipate challenges and take proactive steps to prevent service gaps.
  • Work closely with the reservations, supply, finance and sales teams across different regions to ensure smooth communication and coordination of guest requirements or special requests.


Feedback Collection & Reporting:

  • Encourage guests to complete feedback surveys and track satisfaction trends.
  • Share insights with internal teams and suppliers to drive ongoing service enhancements.
  • Contribute ideas and recommendations for improving the overall guest and supplier experience.
  • VIP & Corporate Account Management:
  • Handle the needs of high-profile, VIP guests, or corporate accounts, ensuring that all special requirements are met, from booking preferences to additional services.




Qualifications & Competencies

Experience:

  • Minimum 3 years in guest relations, hospitality, account management, or supplier coordination.
  • Background in serviced apartments, hotels, or travel services beneficial.


Skills:

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and negotiation abilities.
  • Ability to prioritise and manage multiple stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in CRM or guest/supplier management systems.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English required; Spanish highly beneficial.


Personal Attributes:

  • Empathetic, approachable, and culturally sensitive.
  • Confident in managing expectations for both guests and suppliers.
  • Proactive and adaptable in a fast-paced global environment.
  • Collaborative team player with a passion for service excellence.


Education:

  • Degree in Hospitality, Business, or related field desirable but not essential.


Why Join Us?

  • Bridge Role Impact: Play a key part in delivering exceptional experiences by supporting both guests and suppliers.
  • Global Exposure: Work with diverse clients and partners across multiple regions.
  • Dynamic Culture: Join a friendly, collaborative team where new ideas are celebrated.
  • Competitive Package: Attractive salary and benefits.


Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: R$6,500.00 - R$7,500.00 per month

  • Figma Básico/Intermediário: Auto Layout e criação de componentes simples.
  • Noções de Design System: Entender a importância de usar cores, fontes e botões padronizados.

title: Product Owner
description:
About InComm

InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.


About This Opportunity

As a Product Owner, you will work closely with both our Business Intelligence and Reporting Teams. In this position you will be accountable to manage data and reporting requirements to fulfill stakeholder or customer requests. You will also lead the roadmap and requirements analysis primarily for our financial systems.


The ideal candidate will have experience with Scrum/ Agile processes, Accounting/Financial Systems, SSRS, PowerBI, and Tableau. Knowledge of ETL and Oracle/Oracle EBS is a plus.


Professional English Language skills are required.


Position is CLT and fully remote (must reside in Brazil). Benefits include health and dental insurance, meal and restaurant vouchers, fixed monthly stipend for Internet and mobile expenses, InComm hardware/software, and annual bonuses!



Responsibilities

  • Work directly with Finance & Accounting leadership and BI teams on product backlog and coordinate with various technology teams across InComm to implement new solutions.
  • Build, manage and prioritize product backlog based on the overall strategy and business objectives for future product development.
  • Responsible for creating and/or managing following artifacts:

-Road Map

-Development Backlog

-User Stories and Sprint Tasks

-Supporting documents for user stories


  • Monitor and Review ServiceNow (SNOW) requests
  • Create product vision and roadmap which accomplishes the goal of the vision and convey that vision to the scrum team.
  • Ensure user stories are well defined and ready for development to begin.
  • Responsible for optimizing the value of the work done.
  • Accountable for each stage of the development process and the final product.
  • Ensure close collaboration with development team. Be available to address any questions team members have regarding requirements or implementation of a product feature.
  • Responsible for communicating with stakeholders across the board, including product managers, leadership, customers, and the development team to make sure their vision is aligned with business objectives.


Preferred Qualifications/Experience:

  • Experience with reporting and operations within Billing, Accounting, and Sales
  • Experience working in Agile/Technical environments
  • Skilled in and comfortable working alongside technical stakeholders, translating business needs into clear, actionable inputs for development or support teams.
  • Proficient in Agile/Scrum
  • Agile/Scrum Certification
  • General knowledge of ERP, Databases (Oracle & MS SQL) and DataLakesis a plus
  • SRS, PowerBI, and Tableau and knowledge of ETL.


InComm provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or national origin, citizenship, veteran’s status, age, disability status, genetics or any other category protected by federal, state, or local law.

title: GenAI Solution Architect
description:
GenAI Solution Architect

Brazil/Argentina (Remote)

Full Time


In this role, you will:

  • Champion Software Excellence & Talent Development. Promote strong SDLC practices including clean architecture, automated testing, and scalable design. Mentor junior developers through code reviews, technical guidance, and collaborative learning to foster a high-performing engineering culture.
  • Lead Automation use cases architecture using technologies like GenAI, API, D&A, etc, working closely with Product Managers, automation engineers and stakeholders across business and DTS, and Enterprise Architecture.
  • End-to-End Platform Development. Build and maintain front-end (React, TypeScript, Next.js) and back-end (Python, FastAPI, Node.js) layers that support GenAI workflows and agentic interactions.
  • API & Agent Framework Integration. Design robust REST and GraphQL APIs for real-time agent communication, tool execution, and memory handling. Integrate frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, and vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma, Weaviate).
  • ETL & Data Pipeline Architecture. Architect and optimize ETL pipelines for real-time and batch data processing. Ensure seamless data flow between GenAI services, databases, and user interfaces.
  • Cloud-Native Deployment & Monitoring. Deploy and scale services using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines. Apply MLOps best practices for monitoring, versioning, and performance tuning of AI components.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration. Work closely with AI researchers, product managers, and delivery teams to align technical execution with strategic goals. Participate in multi-agent orchestration experiments and rapid prototyping cycles.


Technical Expertise:

  • Cloud Platform Proficiency: Solid experience (minimum 5 years) in architecting, deploying, and managing applications across leading cloud platforms, demonstrating comprehensive knowledge of cloud services including computing, database management, application development, and integration services. Familiarity with cloud-native services (Azure), containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes), and serverless architectures is highly valued.
  • Embedded Systems and CI/CD: Experience with embedded devices, operating systems, and server-client architecture. Proficient in CI/CD and DevSecOps practices.
  • Architecture Design: Experience in Microservices and Event-Driven Architecture. Understanding architecture design principles and patterns. Experience with SQL Server, Web Services (SOAP/REST) and API development.

  • Cloud Architecture Design: Deep understanding of cloud solutions and architectures, enabling scalable, flexible, and resilient digital infrastructures that support rapid innovation and development.


Soft Skills and Others:

  • Agile Collaboration: Demonstrated experience in effectively working with Agile and Product teams, including involvement with epics, user stories, sprints, and backlog management. The ability to collaborate closely with product owners, engineers, and scrum master’s to foster a productive and agile environment.
  • Leadership in Communication and Reporting: Skilled in leading communication efforts and reporting, adept at preparing and presenting comprehensive updates and reports to senior leaders and stakeholders. Ability to succinctly highlight key metrics, progress, and insights, ensuring transparency and alignment at all levels of the organization.

  • Justificar a escolha dos padrões em relação aos requisitos.
  • Considerar os trade-offs entre simplicidade e flexibilidade.
  • Definir estratégias claras para lidar com o aumento da carga (escalabilidade).
  • Implementar mecanismos de recuperação de falhas (resiliência).
  • Atender ao requisito de não indisponibilidade do serviço de controle de lançamentos em caso de falha do consolidado diário. ➢ Definir como os componentes se comunicam (protocolos, formatos de mensagem, etc).
  • Escolher ferramentas de integração adequadas e suas responsabilidades.
  • Implementar autenticação, autorização e criptografia (segurança).
  • Implementar mecanismos de proteção contra ataques (WAF, etc).
  • Analisar a qualidade da divisão do sistema em partes menores e gerenciáveis.
  • Abstrair e segregar responsabilidades entre as camadas.


Implementação:

  • Garantir a aderência às boas práticas de desenvolvimento (Solid, Clean Code, etc).
  • Escrever código legível, organizado e de fácil manutenção.
  • Utilizar a linguagem C# de forma eficiente.
  • Implementar testes com boa cobertura, qualidade e relevância.
  • Cumprir os requisitos técnicos obrigatórios.
  • Atender aos requisitos de negócio.


Documentação e Apresentação:

  • Documentar a arquitetura de forma clara e concisa.
  • Criar diagramas que representam a arquitetura.
  • Justificar as decisões arquiteturais.
  • Definir os fluxos de dados.
  • Escrever instruções claras e detalhadas de como a aplicação funciona e como rodar localmente (Readme).
  • Centralizar documentações.
  • Descrever possíveis melhorias ou expansões do sistema.
  • Demonstrar capacidade de visão e planejamento a longo prazo.
  • Discutir trade-offs e desafios enfrentados durante o desenvolvimento.


Diferenciais e Boas Práticas:

  • Garantir que o código seja executado de forma local e sem erros.
  • Utilizar estratégias de Docker e Docker Compose.
  • Implementar pipeline automatizada (CI/CD).
  • Utilizar estratégias de IaC (Infraestrutura como Código).
  • Realizar estimativas de custos.

Requisitos e qualificações:

Experiência:

  • Experiência comprovada em design e implementação de arquiteturas de software escaláveis, resilientes e seguras.
  • Experiência prática em desenvolvimento de software utilizando a linguagem C#.
  • Experiência com a aplicação de princípios de design de software (SOLID, Clean Code, etc.).
  • Experiência com a implementação de testes automatizados (unitários, integração, etc.).
  • Experiência com padrões de arquitetura (microsserviços, filas de mensagens, etc.).


Conhecimento Técnico:

  • Profundo conhecimento da linguagem C# e do ecossistema .NET.
  • Sólido conhecimento de padrões de design de software (Design Patterns).
  • Conhecimento de princípios de arquitetura de software (microsserviços, filas de mensagens, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de práticas de desenvolvimento ágil (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Conhecimento de segurança da informação (autenticação, autorização, criptografia).
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de versionamento de código (Git).
  • Familiaridade com metodologias de testes (TDD, BDD).
  • Familiaridade com Docker e Docker Compose.
  • Conhecimento de CI/CD (Integração Contínua / Entrega Contínua).
  • Conhecimento de IaC (Infraestrutura como Código).


Habilidades:

  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação e colaboração para trabalhar em equipe.
  • Habilidade de análise crítica e resolução de problemas complexos.
  • Capacidade de traduzir requisitos de negócios em especificações técnicas claras e concisas.

title: Senior Elixir Developer
description:
Who We Are Seeking:


We’re looking for a talented and experienced Elixir Backend Developer to join our international team and help design, build, and harden our agentic contracts execution layer —the platform where autonomous/agent-driven workflows orchestrate and execute contractual logic reliably, at scale. This role presents an excellent opportunity for those looking to work in a dynamic environment and be part of a high-performing international team, offering ample opportunities for growth and development in technical and interpersonal skills. Your Role and Responsibilities:  

  • Design and implement Elixir/OTP services (GenServer, Supervision trees, Registries) that power contract execution and agentic workflows.
  • Own the lifecycle of long-running, event-driven workflows (timers, scheduling, compensations/Saga patterns, exactly-once/at-least-once semantics).
  • Develop secure APIs and integrations, rate limiting, and request budgets for agent calls.
  • Optimize performance (ETS, streams, batching, backpressure) and observability (tracing, metrics, structured logs).
  • Collaborate with Product and AI/Agent teams to translate requirements into deterministic, testable contract execution flows.
  • Write high-quality tests, migrations, and production-grade documentation.


Tech You’ll Use:

  • Elixir /OTP (GenServer, Supervisors, Applications), Phoenix (APIs), Ecto (PostgreSQL), Oban, OpenTelemetry/PromEx
  • Message brokers & streams: Kafka or RabbitMQ
  • Container & cloud: Docker , Kubernetes , AWS/GCP/Azure
  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions (or similar), feature flags, migrations & rollout strategies


Essential Qualifications:  

  • 3+ years building production Elixir/OTP services (or 5+ years BE + 1–2 years Elixir with strong OTP fundamentals).
  • Deep understanding of concurrency, supervision strategies, and fault tolerance on the BEAM.
  • Solid experience with Ecto/MySQL , schema design, transactions, and migrations.
  • Practical knowledge of job orchestration (Oban or equivalent), idempotency, retries, and backpressure.
  • Proven track record in building and maintaining event-driven or workflow systems with strong correctness guarantees.
  • Comfortable with containerized deployments and CI/CD; you ship and you own.
  • Strong written and spoken English (daily collaboration in English).

title: Global Guest Experience Coordinator
description:
Job Title: Global Guest Experience Coordinator

Location: Remote – Sao Paulo, Brazil

Department: Guest Experience

Working hours: Shifts range from 6 a.m. to 2 a.m., with 8-hour shifts. You will work 5 days out of 7 , including weekends depending on the rota.


Reports To: Head of Global Guest Experience / Global Guest Experience Manager


About Us

QIG is a dynamic group comprising three companies:

  • Q Global Network (QGN): A global serviced apartment agency working with suppliers around the world.
  • Aeria Apartments: A London-based serviced apartment provider.
  • QDK: Q Apartments Denmark, offering stress-free beginnings in and around Copenhagen


Together, we provide premium, fully furnished apartments for business and leisure travellers worldwide. Our mission is to deliver a seamless “home away from home” experience with unparalleled service, comfort, and convenience.


Although this position focuses on QDK, there is close cross-team collaboration across all three companies’ Guest Experience teams, ensuring we share knowledge, best practices, and consistently deliver exceptional service to both guests and suppliers.


Role Overv iew

The Global Guest Experience Coordinator is responsible for delivering a seamless, high-quality guest journey from pre-arrival to check-out, acting as the main point of contact for guest communication and support. The role combines exceptional customer service with effective problem-solving, ensuring issues are handled quickly, empathetically, and professionally.


Working closely with internal teams (including reservations, sales, operations, supply, and finance) and external partners such as approved suppliers, landlords, and managing agents worldwide, you will coordinate services, manage escalations, and help maintain consistent standards across the guest experience. You will also gather and analyse guest feedback, monitor partner performance, and contribute ideas to continuously improve service delivery—particularly for VIP and corporate accounts where attention to detail and discretion are essential.


Key Responsibilities

Guest Experience

  • Be the main point of contact for guests, responding to inquiries by email, phone, and live chat with professionalism and warmth.
  • Guide guests through the full journey—from pre-arrival checks to check-out—ensuring they feel supported at every stage.
  • Manage guest issues with empathy and efficiency, escalating only when necessary.


Complaint Resolution & Escalation Management:

  • Liaise daily with internal department like reservations, sales and operational team as well as approved suppliers, landlords, and managing agents across the globe to ensure smooth delivery of services.
  • Communicate guest feedback and issues to suppliers clearly, ensuring timely action.
  • Build and maintain strong, positive relationships with suppliers to foster trust and collaboration.
  • Monitor supplier performance and suggest improvements to strengthen our product.


Cross-Functional Collaboration:

  • Balance guest needs with operational & supplier capabilities to create win–win outcomes.
  • Anticipate challenges and take proactive steps to prevent service gaps.
  • Work closely with the reservations, supply, finance and sales teams across different regions to ensure smooth communication and coordination of guest requirements or special requests.


Feedback Collection & Reporting:

  • Encourage guests to complete feedback surveys and track satisfaction trends.
  • Share insights with internal teams and suppliers to drive ongoing service enhancements.
  • Contribute ideas and recommendations for improving the overall guest and supplier experience.
  • VIP & Corporate Account Management:
  • Handle the needs of high-profile, VIP guests, or corporate accounts, ensuring that all special requirements are met, from booking preferences to additional services.




Qualifications & Competencies

Experience:

  • Minimum 3 years in guest relations, hospitality, account management, or supplier coordination.
  • Background in serviced apartments, hotels, or travel services beneficial.


Skills:

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and negotiation abilities.
  • Ability to prioritise and manage multiple stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in CRM or guest/supplier management systems.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English required; Spanish highly beneficial.


Personal Attributes:

  • Empathetic, approachable, and culturally sensitive.
  • Confident in managing expectations for both guests and suppliers.
  • Proactive and adaptable in a fast-paced global environment.
  • Collaborative team player with a passion for service excellence.


Education:

  • Degree in Hospitality, Business, or related field desirable but not essential.


Why Join Us?

  • Bridge Role Impact: Play a key part in delivering exceptional experiences by supporting both guests and suppliers.
  • Global Exposure: Work with diverse clients and partners across multiple regions.
  • Dynamic Culture: Join a friendly, collaborative team where new ideas are celebrated.
  • Competitive Package: Attractive salary and benefits.


Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: R$6,500.00 - R$7,500.00 per month

Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.


Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas.

Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família.

title: Product Owner
description:
Descrição da vaga

  • Organizar junto as áreas, o desenvolvimento dos produtos e serviços alinhados à estratégia do negócio, com o objetivo de definir e priorizar os requisitos do produto e garantir que o produto atenda às necessidades dos usuários e do negócio. Atuar como um representante dos stakeholders (partes interessadas) e trabalhar em estreita colaboração com o time de desenvolvimento para garantir que o produto atenda às necessidades do cliente e do negócio.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Analisar, interpretar e construir a documentação e informações de sistemas compreendendo processos e regras de negócio mapeados, contribuindo para a definição da arquitetura e implementação da solução para atendimento das necessidades de negócio existentes;
  • Mapear, refinar e documentar regras de negócio, requisitos funcionais e não funcionais, histórias de usuário relativas ao produto;
  • Contextualizar funcionalidades e sistemas à processos e regras de negócio, demonstrando análise crítica e empenho no seu esclarecimento para suportar sua correta implementação;
  • Ser capaz de mapear os pontos de integração da solução e dos processos;
  • Orientar a análise, modelagem e documentação de requisitos funcionais e não funcionais;
  • Conduzir o entendimento do problema e definição da solução (processo de discovery: entender, alinhar e comunicar o objetivo do produto) de propostas complexas, de acordo com os critérios de aceite do cliente;
  • Elaborar, priorizar e manter atualizado o roadmap e realizar o gerenciamento e refinamento do backlog de desenvolvimento do projeto/produto.;
  • Construção de fluxos e prototipos de baixa fidelidade;
  • Garantir o entendimento do time de desenvolvimento referente aos itens do backlog do produto;
  • Conduzir os ritos da metodologia utilizada para desenvolvimento do produto (por exemplo ritos do Scrum: Sprint Planning, Sprint Review, Retrospectiva etc.);
  • Realizar o controle de Burn down do projeto;
  • Garantir que os clientes internos e externos estejam alinhados quanto aos prazos e entregas;
  • Acompanhamento, homologação e reporte das entregas;
  • Reporte de informações do projeto a Gerência de Operações e/ou Gerente de Projetos a fim de subsidiar as decisões estratégicas;
  • Identificar e endereçar oportunidades de evolução do produto, para melhor atender as necessidades dos usuários;
  • Cumprir as diretrizes de segurança da informação e compliance estabelecidas pelo Grupo Imagem.


Requisitos e qualificações

Formação :

  • Graduado.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Capacidade de análise crítica de especificações de sistemas e negócios;
  • Capacidade de comunicação e escrita clara, objetiva e organizada;
  • Capacidade de atuar com metodologias ágeis de desenvolvimento de software;
  • Capacidade de aferir a qualidade da entrega através de validação das especificações.
  • Conhecimento em acompanhamento e controle de indicadores (KPIs).


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Certificações;
  • Inglês Intermediário/Avançado;
  • Conhecimentos em GIS;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de prototipação;
  • Conhecimento e compreensão em profundidade dos produtos e serviços oferecidos pela Vega (Tecnologia da Informação ou Agronegócio);
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de apoio para ideação, especificação, prototipação e validação de sistemas;
  • Mapeamento de processos;
  • Metodologias ágeis (exemplo: Framework Scrum etc);
  • Análise de Dados;
  • Conhecimento sobre o CAR (Cadastro Ambiental Rural).


Informações adicionais

Por que escolher a VEGA?


Modelo de Trabalho Moderno:

Trabalho 100% Remoto ou Híbrido, se você estiver próximo à nossa sede (São José dos Campos) ou hubs (Lavras e Piracicaba).


Saúde e Bem-Estar:

Plano de Saúde: Sul América ou Unimed (conforme localidade).

title: ESPECIALISTA EM OPERAÇÃO E EFICIÊNCIA - ENERGIA
description:
Quer fazer parte de um time que impulsiona o progresso por meio da energia?


Na Light, buscamos alguém que terá como missão ser responsável por liderar os processos processos analíticos estratégicos voltados à operação de sistemas elétricos de Alta, Média e Baixa Tensão (AT, MT e BT), operações de campo, qualidade regulatória, eficiência operacional e ciência de dados. Deverá estar apto a analisar e aplicar modelos operacionais, estudos de capacidade, dimensionamento e de desempenho operacional utilizando modelos matemáticos/estatísticos/econométricos, para indicar soluções numéricas para problemas de projeção e análise de impactos operacionais e regulatórios. Deverá focar sua atuação na construção de análises de impacto operacional, visando mensurar, modelar e projetar cenários quantitativos e qualitativos, de modo a avaliar os efeitos sobre indicadores estratégicos e operacionais da organização.



Seus principais desafios serão:


  • Pensar estrategicamente a operação (fora da caixa);
  • Criar novos modelos matemáticos/estatísticos para análise de dados e projeções diversas (dimensionamento, demandas, despacho, TMA, DEC, FEC, Compensações, etc);
  • Conduzir estudos quantitativos e analíticos;
  • Apresentar relatórios e conclusões com base nas modelagens aplicadas;
  • Analisar e reproduzir metodologias operacionais;
  • Estudar e manter-se atualizado quanto ao estado da arte em operação;
  • Criar alternativas “data driven” para subsídio gerencial da Light;
  • Estabelecer profundo relacionamento interno com as áreas operacionais, regulatórias, TI e financeiras da Light, para suporte operacional a tomada de decisão;
  • Produzir estudos de benchmarking;
  • Ser referência em conhecimento ágil para solução de problemas.


Requisitos necessários:


  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Mestrado ou MBA em Economia ou Engenharia;
  • Desejável: Conhecimento de linguagem de programação aplicada a ciência de dados, como Phyton ou R.

description:
